import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// FE-06: fixed colors plus a text label and a glyph, so the action is never conveyed by color alone.
const STYLES: Record<string, { cls: string; glyph: string }> = {
  allow: { cls: "border-green-700 bg-green-100 text-green-900", glyph: "✓" },
  flag: { cls: "border-amber-600 bg-amber-100 text-amber-950", glyph: "⚑" },
  sanitize: { cls: "border-blue-700 bg-blue-100 text-blue-900", glyph: "✂" },
  block: { cls: "border-red-700 bg-red-100 text-red-900", glyph: "⛔" },
};

export const ACTION_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  allow: "#15803d",
  flag: "#d97706",
  sanitize: "#1d4ed8",
  block: "#b91c1c",
};

export function actionLabel(action: string, wouldAction?: string | null): string {
  const a = action.toUpperCase();
  if (wouldAction && wouldAction !== action) return `${a} (would ${wouldAction.toUpperCase()})`;
  return a;
}

export function ActionBadge({ action, wouldAction, className }: { action: string; wouldAction?: string | null; className?: string }) {
  const style = STYLES[action] ?? { cls: "border-slate-400 bg-slate-100 text-slate-900", glyph: "•" };
  return (
    <Badge className={cn(style.cls, className)} data-action={action}>
      <span aria-hidden>{style.glyph}</span>
      <span>{actionLabel(action, wouldAction)}</span>
    </Badge>
  );
}

import { fmtScore } from "@/lib/format";

export interface Thresholds {
  flag: number;
  sanitize: number;
  block: number;
}

/** Risk score as a number plus a horizontal bar with the flag/sanitize/block thresholds marked (FE-06). */
export function RiskBar({ risk, thresholds }: { risk: number; thresholds?: Thresholds | null }) {
  const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, risk)) * 100;
  const marks = thresholds
    ? ([
        ["Flag", thresholds.flag],
        ["Sanitize", thresholds.sanitize],
        ["Block", thresholds.block],
      ] as const)
    : [];
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
        <span className="text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums" data-testid="risk-score">
          {fmtScore(risk)}
        </span>
        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">risk score (0–1)</span>
      </div>
      <div
        className="relative mt-2 h-3 w-full rounded-full bg-slate-200"
        role="meter"
        aria-label="Risk score"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={1}
        aria-valuenow={Number(risk.toFixed(2))}
      >
        <div className="h-3 rounded-full bg-slate-700" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />
        {marks.map(([label, v]) => (
          <span key={label} aria-hidden className="absolute -top-1 h-5 w-0.5 bg-slate-900" style={{ left: `${v * 100}%` }} />
        ))}
      </div>
      {marks.length ? (
        <div className="relative mt-1 h-4 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden>
          {marks.map(([label, v]) => (
            <span key={label} className="absolute -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap" style={{ left: `${v * 100}%` }}>
              {label} {fmtScore(v)}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {thresholds ? (
        <p className="sr-only">
          Thresholds: flag {fmtScore(thresholds.flag)}, sanitize {fmtScore(thresholds.sanitize)}, block {fmtScore(thresholds.block)}.
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Alert } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/toast";
import { isApiError } from "@/lib/api-client";

export interface DisplayError {
  status: number;
  code: string;
  message: string;
  requestId: string;
  retryAfterSeconds?: number | null;
}

export function toDisplayError(e: unknown): DisplayError {
  if (isApiError(e)) {
    return { status: e.status, code: e.code, message: e.message, requestId: e.requestId, retryAfterSeconds: e.retryAfterSeconds };
  }
  return { status: 0, code: "INTERNAL", message: "Something went wrong", requestId: "" };
}

/** FE-18: inline message that shows the request_id so it can be reported. */
export function ApiErrorMessage({ error, title, className }: { error: DisplayError | null; title?: string; className?: string }) {
  if (!error) return null;
  return (
    <Alert tone="error" title={title ?? "Request failed"} className={className}>
      <p>{error.message}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs">
        Code: <code>{error.code}</code>
        {error.requestId ? (
          <>
            {" "}
            · Request ID: <code className="select-all">{error.requestId}</code>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </p>
    </Alert>
  );
}

/** Returns a handler that converts an error, shows a toast and returns it for inline display. */
export function useErrorToast() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  return React.useCallback(
    (e: unknown, title = "Request failed"): DisplayError => {
      const err = toDisplayError(e);
      toast({ tone: "error", title, description: err.requestId ? `${err.message} (request ${err.requestId})` : err.message });
      return err;
    },
    [toast],
  );
}

import { splitAtSpans, type Span } from "@/lib/highlight";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * Renders untrusted text with span highlights. Everything is a React text node; highlighted
 * pieces are wrapped in <mark>. No HTML parsing, no markdown, no auto-linking (FE-14).
 */
export function HighlightedText({ text, spans, className }: { text: string; spans: Span[]; className?: string }) {
  const pieces = splitAtSpans(text, spans);
  return (
    <pre className={cn("whitespace-pre-wrap break-words rounded-md border bg-muted/40 p-3 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed", className)}>
      {pieces.map((p, i) =>
        p.highlighted ? (
          <mark key={i} title={p.labels.join(", ") || undefined} className="rounded-sm bg-yellow-200 px-0.5 text-slate-950 underline decoration-dotted">
            {p.text}
          </mark>
        ) : (
          <span key={i}>{p.text}</span>
        ),
      )}
    </pre>
  );
}

export function PlainText({ text, className }: { text: string; className?: string }) {
  return <pre className={cn("whitespace-pre-wrap break-words rounded-md border bg-muted/40 p-3 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed", className)}>{text}</pre>;
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

export function CopyButton({ value, label = "Copy", className }: { value: string; label?: string; className?: string }) {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<"idle" | "copied" | "failed">("idle");
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (state === "idle") return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setState("idle"), 2000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [state]);
  return (
    <Button
      variant="outline"
      size="sm"
      className={className}
      onClick={async () => {
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
          setState("copied");
        } catch {
          setState("failed");
        }
      }}
    >
      {state === "copied" ? "Copied" : state === "failed" ? "Copy failed" : label}
      <span className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">
        {state === "copied" ? "Copied to clipboard" : ""}
      </span>
    </Button>
  );
}

import type { Finding, ScanResult, Segment, VerdictDetail } from "@/lib/schemas";

// View model shared by the playground result panel and the verdict detail page.

export interface LayerCell<T> {
  value: T | null;
  /** Why the layer did not run (tooltip for "—"). */
  skipped?: string;
}

export interface SegmentRow {
  ref: string;
  source?: string;
  trust?: string;
  risk: number;
  action: string;
  heuristic: LayerCell<{ score: number; rules: string[] }>;
  classifier: LayerCell<{ score: number; chunks?: number }>;
  judge: LayerCell<{ label: string; confidence: number | null; reason: string; category?: string | null }>;
}

export interface ScanView {
  action: string;
  wouldAction?: string | null;
  risk: number;
  degraded: boolean;
  segments: SegmentRow[];
  findings: Finding[];
  sanitized?: { input?: string | null; context_docs?: (string | null)[] } | null;
  latency?: { total: number; l1?: number | null; l2?: number | null; l3?: number | null } | null;
  versions?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface LayerContext {
  degraded: boolean;
  judgeEnabled?: boolean;
  grayZone?: { low: number; high: number } | null;
}

const SKIP_REASONS: Record<string, string> = {
  not_in_gray_zone: "Not in gray zone — pre-score was clearly benign or clearly malicious",
  judge_disabled: "Judge disabled for this scan",
  disabled: "Layer disabled by policy",
  budget_exhausted: "Judge budget exhausted — higher-scoring segments were judged first",
  output_segment: "Judge is not run on LLM output (v1)",
  timeout: "Layer timed out — result is degraded",
  error: "Layer errored — result is degraded",
  not_requested: "Per-layer details were not requested (explain=false)",
};

export function describeSkip(code: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!code) return undefined;
  return SKIP_REASONS[code] ?? code.replace(/_/g, " ");
}

function judgeSkipReason(seg: { trust?: string; preScore: number | null }, ctx: LayerContext): string {
  if (ctx.judgeEnabled === false) return SKIP_REASONS.judge_disabled!;
  if (seg.trust === "output") return SKIP_REASONS.output_segment!;
  if (ctx.grayZone && seg.preScore !== null && (seg.preScore < ctx.grayZone.low || seg.preScore >= ctx.grayZone.high)) {
    return `Not in gray zone — pre-score ${seg.preScore.toFixed(2)} is outside [${ctx.grayZone.low.toFixed(2)}, ${ctx.grayZone.high.toFixed(2)})`;
  }
  if (ctx.judgeEnabled && ctx.grayZone) return SKIP_REASONS.budget_exhausted!;
  return "Judge did not run for this segment (not in gray zone, disabled or over budget)";
}

function num(v: unknown): number | null {
  return typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
}

interface FlatLayers {
  hScore: number | null;
  hRules: string[];
  hSkip?: string;
  cScore: number | null;
  cChunks?: number;
  cSkip?: string;
  jLabel: string | null;
  jConf: number | null;
  jReason: string;
  jCategory?: string | null;
  jSkip?: string;
}

function buildRow(base: { ref: string; source?: string; trust?: string; risk: number; action: string }, l: FlatLayers, ctx: LayerContext): SegmentRow {
  const preScore = l.hScore === null && l.cScore === null ? null : Math.max(l.hScore ?? 0, l.cScore ?? 0);
  return {
    ...base,
    heuristic:
      l.hScore !== null
        ? { value: { score: l.hScore, rules: l.hRules } }
        : { value: null, skipped: describeSkip(l.hSkip) ?? "Heuristic details not available for this segment" },
    classifier:
      l.cScore !== null
        ? { value: { score: l.cScore, chunks: l.cChunks } }
        : {
            value: null,
            skipped:
              describeSkip(l.cSkip) ??
              (ctx.degraded ? "Classifier unavailable (timed out or errored) — result is degraded" : "Classifier did not run for this segment"),
          },
    judge: l.jLabel
      ? { value: { label: l.jLabel, confidence: l.jConf, reason: l.jReason, category: l.jCategory } }
      : { value: null, skipped: describeSkip(l.jSkip) ?? judgeSkipReason({ trust: base.trust, preScore }, ctx) },
  };
}

export function segmentFromResult(s: Segment, ctx: LayerContext): SegmentRow {
  const h = s.layers?.heuristic;
  const c = s.layers?.classifier;
  const j = s.layers?.judge;
  return buildRow(
    { ref: s.ref, source: s.source, trust: s.trust, risk: s.risk, action: s.action },
    {
      hScore: num(h?.score),
      hRules: h?.rules ?? [],
      hSkip: h?.skipped_reason,
      cScore: num(c?.score),
      cChunks: c?.chunks,
      cSkip: c?.skipped_reason,
      jLabel: j?.label ?? null,
      jConf: num(j?.confidence),
      jReason: j?.reason ?? "",
      jCategory: j?.category,
      jSkip: j?.skipped_reason,
    },
    ctx,
  );
}

export function scanViewFromResult(r: ScanResult, ctx: Omit<LayerContext, "degraded">): ScanView {
  const full: LayerContext = { ...ctx, degraded: r.degraded };
  return {
    action: r.action,
    wouldAction: r.would_action,
    risk: r.risk_score,
    degraded: r.degraded,
    segments: r.segments.map((s) => segmentFromResult(s, full)),
    findings: r.findings,
    sanitized: r.sanitized ?? null,
    latency: r.latency_ms,
    versions: r.versions,
  };
}

export function scanViewFromVerdict(v: VerdictDetail): ScanView {
  const ctx: LayerContext = { degraded: v.degraded };
  const segments = v.segments_summary.map((s) => {
    const lh = s.layers?.heuristic;
    const lc = s.layers?.classifier;
    const lj = s.layers?.judge;
    return buildRow(
      { ref: s.ref, source: s.source, trust: s.trust, risk: s.risk, action: s.action },
      {
        hScore: num(lh?.score) ?? num(s.heuristic_score),
        hRules: lh?.rules ?? s.heuristic_rules ?? [],
        hSkip: lh?.skipped_reason,
        cScore: num(lc?.score) ?? num(s.classifier_score),
        cChunks: lc?.chunks,
        cSkip: lc?.skipped_reason,
        jLabel: lj?.label ?? s.judge_label ?? null,
        jConf: num(lj?.confidence) ?? num(s.judge_confidence),
        jReason: lj?.reason ?? s.judge_reason ?? "",
        jCategory: lj?.category,
        jSkip: lj?.skipped_reason,
      },
      ctx,
    );
  });
  const latency = typeof v.latency_ms === "object" && v.latency_ms ? v.latency_ms : null;
  return {
    action: v.action,
    wouldAction: v.would_action,
    risk: v.risk_score,
    degraded: v.degraded,
    segments,
    findings: v.findings,
    sanitized: null,
    latency,
    versions: v.versions,
  };
}

/** Findings whose spans can be shown on the given top-level ref (derived #hidden/#decoded refs cannot). */
export function spansFor(findings: Finding[], ref: string) {
  return findings
    .filter((f) => f.ref === ref && f.span && f.span.end > f.span.start)
    .map((f) => ({ start: f.span!.start, end: f.span!.end, label: f.category }));
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { ActionBadge } from "@/components/action-badge";
import { CopyButton } from "@/components/copy-button";
import { HighlightedText, PlainText } from "@/components/highlighted-text";
import { RiskBar, type Thresholds } from "@/components/risk-bar";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Alert, TableScroll, td, th } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { Tooltip } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { fmtMs, fmtScore } from "@/lib/format";
import { spansFor, type LayerCell, type ScanView } from "@/lib/scan-view";

function Missing({ cell }: { cell: LayerCell<unknown> }) {
  return (
    <Tooltip content={cell.skipped ?? "Layer did not run"}>
      <span aria-label={`Not run: ${cell.skipped ?? "layer did not run"}`}>—</span>
    </Tooltip>
  );
}

export function LayerTable({ view }: { view: ScanView }) {
  if (!view.segments.length) return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No per-segment details were returned.</p>;
  return (
    <TableScroll label="Per-segment layer results">
      <table className="w-full min-w-[820px] border-collapse">
        <caption className="sr-only">One row per segment with heuristic, classifier and judge results</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col" className={th}>Segment</th>
            <th scope="col" className={th}>Heuristic score</th>
            <th scope="col" className={th}>Matched rules</th>
            <th scope="col" className={th}>Classifier score</th>
            <th scope="col" className={th}>Judge label</th>
            <th scope="col" className={th}>Judge confidence</th>
            <th scope="col" className={th}>Judge reason</th>
            <th scope="col" className={th}>Segment risk</th>
            <th scope="col" className={th}>Segment action</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {view.segments.map((s) => (
            <tr key={s.ref}>
              <th scope="row" className={`${td} text-left font-mono text-xs font-medium`}>
                {s.ref}
                {s.source ? <span className="block text-[11px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">{s.source}{s.trust ? ` · ${s.trust}` : ""}</span> : null}
              </th>
              <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{s.heuristic.value ? fmtScore(s.heuristic.value.score) : <Missing cell={s.heuristic} />}</td>
              <td className={`${td} font-mono text-xs`}>
                {s.heuristic.value ? (s.heuristic.value.rules.length ? s.heuristic.value.rules.join(", ") : "none") : <Missing cell={s.heuristic} />}
              </td>
              <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>
                {s.classifier.value ? (
                  <>
                    {fmtScore(s.classifier.value.score)}
                    {s.classifier.value.chunks ? <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground"> ({s.classifier.value.chunks} chunks)</span> : null}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <Missing cell={s.classifier} />
                )}
              </td>
              <td className={td}>{s.judge.value ? s.judge.value.label : <Missing cell={s.judge} />}</td>
              <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{s.judge.value ? fmtScore(s.judge.value.confidence) : <Missing cell={s.judge} />}</td>
              <td className={`${td} max-w-[22rem] whitespace-pre-wrap break-words`}>{s.judge.value ? s.judge.value.reason || "—" : <Missing cell={s.judge} />}</td>
              <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtScore(s.risk)}</td>
              <td className={td}>
                <ActionBadge action={s.action} />
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </TableScroll>
  );
}

const SEVERITY_CLS: Record<string, string> = {
  low: "border-slate-400 bg-slate-100 text-slate-900",
  medium: "border-amber-600 bg-amber-50 text-amber-950",
  high: "border-orange-700 bg-orange-50 text-orange-950",
  critical: "border-red-700 bg-red-50 text-red-900",
};

export function FindingsList({ view }: { view: ScanView }) {
  if (!view.findings.length) return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No findings.</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-2" aria-label="Findings">
      {view.findings.map((f, i) => (
        <li key={`${f.ref}-${f.category}-${i}`} className="rounded-md border p-3" data-testid="finding" data-category={f.category}>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Badge className="border-slate-500 bg-white font-mono text-slate-900">{f.category}</Badge>
            <Badge className={SEVERITY_CLS[String(f.severity)] ?? SEVERITY_CLS.low}>severity: {String(f.severity)}</Badge>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              layer: {f.layer} · <span className="font-mono">{f.ref}</span>
              {f.span ? ` · chars ${f.span.start}–${f.span.end}` : ""}
              {f.ref.includes("#") ? " (derived segment)" : ""}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm">{f.reason || "—"}</p>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

export function LatencyBreakdown({ latency }: { latency: ScanView["latency"] }) {
  if (!latency) return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No latency data.</p>;
  const rows: [string, number | null | undefined][] = [
    ["Total", latency.total],
    ["L1 heuristics", latency.l1],
    ["L2 classifier", latency.l2],
    ["L3 judge", latency.l3],
  ];
  return (
    <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
      {rows.map(([k, v]) => (
        <div key={k} className="rounded-md border p-2">
          <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{k}</dt>
          <dd className="text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums">{fmtMs(v)}</dd>
        </div>
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}

export function RawJson({ value }: { value: unknown }) {
  const json = React.useMemo(() => JSON.stringify(value, null, 2), [value]);
  return (
    <details className="rounded-md border">
      <summary className="cursor-pointer select-none px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium">Raw JSON</summary>
      <div className="border-t p-3">
        <div className="mb-2 flex justify-end">
          <CopyButton value={json} label="Copy JSON" />
        </div>
        <pre className="max-h-[480px] overflow-auto whitespace-pre rounded bg-slate-950 p-3 font-mono text-xs text-slate-50">{json}</pre>
      </div>
    </details>
  );
}

export interface OriginalTexts {
  input?: string;
  context_docs?: { content: string; content_type?: string }[];
}

export function ScanResultPanel({
  view,
  raw,
  thresholds,
  originals,
  extra,
}: {
  view: ScanView;
  raw: unknown;
  thresholds?: Thresholds | null;
  originals?: OriginalTexts;
  extra?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const docs = originals?.context_docs ?? [];
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4" data-testid="scan-result">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Verdict</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Action</span>
            <ActionBadge action={view.action} wouldAction={view.wouldAction} className="px-3 py-1 text-sm" />
            {view.degraded ? (
              <Badge className="border-amber-600 bg-amber-50 text-amber-950">
                <span aria-hidden>⚠</span> Degraded
              </Badge>
            ) : null}
          </div>
          <RiskBar risk={view.risk} thresholds={thresholds} />
          {extra}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Layers</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <LayerTable view={view} />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Findings</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          <FindingsList view={view} />
          {originals?.input ? (
            <div>
              <h3 className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">User input (highlighted spans)</h3>
              <HighlightedText text={originals.input} spans={spansFor(view.findings, "input")} />
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {docs.map((d, i) => (
            <div key={i}>
              <h3 className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Context document {i + 1} (highlighted spans)</h3>
              <HighlightedText text={d.content} spans={spansFor(view.findings, `context_docs[${i}]`)} />
            </div>
          ))}
          {originals ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Span offsets refer to the normalized text, so highlights can shift slightly where whitespace was collapsed.</p> : null}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {docs.length ? (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Sanitized output</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            {docs.map((d, i) => {
              const sanitized = view.sanitized?.context_docs?.[i];
              return (
                <div key={i} className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2" data-testid={`sanitized-doc-${i}`}>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Document {i + 1} — original</h3>
                    <PlainText text={d.content} />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Document {i + 1} — sanitized</h3>
                    {sanitized === undefined || sanitized === null ? (
                      <p className="rounded-md border p-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Not sanitized — the document is passed through unchanged.</p>
                    ) : (
                      <PlainText text={sanitized} className="bg-blue-50/50" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Latency</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <LatencyBreakdown latency={view.latency} />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {view.action === "allow" && view.wouldAction && view.wouldAction !== "allow" ? (
        <Alert tone="info" title="Monitor mode">
          Nothing was blocked: this app is in monitor mode. The action that enforce mode would have taken is shown in brackets.
        </Alert>
      ) : null}

      <RawJson value={raw} />
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { signIn } from "@/auth";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Alert } from "@/components/ui/misc";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Sign in" };

/** Only same-origin relative paths are accepted as callbackUrl (no open redirects). */
function safeCallback(raw: string | string[] | undefined): string {
  const v = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw;
  if (!v || !v.startsWith("/") || v.startsWith("//") || v.startsWith("/\\") || v.startsWith("/login")) return "/playground";
  return v;
}

export default async function LoginPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>> }) {
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const callbackUrl = safeCallback(sp.callbackUrl);
  const error = typeof sp.error === "string" ? sp.error : undefined;

  return (
    <main id="main" className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-muted px-4">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
        <CardHeader>
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground">PIF</p>
          <CardTitle>
            <span className="text-xl">Prompt-Injection Firewall</span>
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Sign in with your organisation account to open the dashboard.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          {error ? (
            <Alert tone="error" title="Sign-in failed">
              Please try again. If the problem continues, ask an administrator to check your account.
            </Alert>
          ) : null}
          <form
            action={async () => {
              "use server";
              await signIn("cognito", { redirectTo: callbackUrl });
            }}
          >
            <Button type="submit" className="w-full">
              Sign in with Cognito
            </Button>
          </form>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">You will be redirected to the Cognito Hosted UI.</p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </main>
  );
}

  if (!session?.user || session.error) redirect("/login");
  const role = session.user.role;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen">
      <header className="border-b bg-white">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 py-2">

            <MainNav />
          </div>
          <details className="relative">
            <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-sm hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring">
              <span className="max-w-[12rem] truncate">{session.user.email ?? session.user.name ?? "Signed in"}</span>
              <Badge
                data-testid="role-badge"
                className={role === "admin" ? "border-purple-700 bg-purple-100 text-purple-900" : "border-slate-500 bg-slate-100 text-slate-900"}

              <p className="px-2 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">

          Your account is not in the <code>admin</code> or <code>analyst</code> group, so the API will refuse most requests.
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <main id="main" className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-6">
        {children}
      </main>

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api-client";
import type { App } from "@/lib/schemas";
import { toDisplayError, type DisplayError } from "@/components/api-error";

export function useApps() {
  const [apps, setApps] = React.useState<App[] | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(null);

  const reload = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch<{ apps: App[] }>("/api/apps");
      setApps(res.apps);
      setError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(toDisplayError(e));
      setApps((prev) => prev ?? []);
    }
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    void reload();
  }, [reload]);

  return { apps, error, reload };
}

import { ScanResultPanel, type OriginalTexts } from "@/components/scan-result-panel";
import { useApps } from "@/components/use-apps";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input, Label, Select, Textarea } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Alert, Spinner } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { PRESETS, type PresetDoc } from "@/lib/presets";
import { scanViewFromResult } from "@/lib/scan-view";
import type { PolicyResponse, ScanResult } from "@/lib/schemas";

interface DocState extends PresetDoc {
  key: number;
}

const SOURCE_TYPES = ["web", "file", "email", "tool", "rag"] as const;
const CONTENT_TYPES = ["text", "html", "markdown"] as const;

export function PlaygroundClient() {
  const { apps, error: appsError } = useApps();
  const [appId, setAppId] = React.useState("");
  const [policy, setPolicy] = React.useState<PolicyResponse | null>(null);
  const [input, setInput] = React.useState("");
  const [docs, setDocs] = React.useState<DocState[]>([]);
  const [runJudge, setRunJudge] = React.useState(true);
  const [presetId, setPresetId] = React.useState("");
  const [scanning, setScanning] = React.useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = React.useState<{ data: ScanResult; originals: OriginalTexts } | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(null);
  const [retryIn, setRetryIn] = React.useState(0);
  const docKey = React.useRef(0);
  const presetRef = React.useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null);
  const showError = useErrorToast();

  // Default to the first active app.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!appId && apps?.length) {
      const first = apps.find((a) => a.status === "active") ?? apps[0];
      if (first) setAppId(first.app_id);
    }
  }, [apps, appId]);

  // Load the selected app's policy for thresholds, gray zone and the judge default.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!appId) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    apiFetch<PolicyResponse>(`/api/apps/${encodeURIComponent(appId)}/policy`)
      .then((p) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setPolicy(p);
        setRunJudge(p.policy.judge_enabled);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setPolicy(null);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [appId]);

  // 429 countdown.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (retryIn <= 0) return;
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setRetryIn((s) => s - 1), 1000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [retryIn]);

  const applyPreset = (id: string) => {
    setPresetId(id);
    const p = PRESETS.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (!p) return;
    setInput(p.input);
    setDocs(p.context_docs.map((d) => ({ ...d, key: ++docKey.current })));
    setResult(null);
    setError(null);
  };

  const addDoc = () => setDocs((ds) => [...ds, { key: ++docKey.current, content: "", source_type: "web", content_type: "text" }]);
  const updateDoc = (key: number, patch: Partial<PresetDoc>) => setDocs((ds) => ds.map((d) => (d.key === key ? { ...d, ...patch } : d)));
  const removeDoc = (key: number) => setDocs((ds) => ds.filter((d) => d.key !== key));

  const canSubmit = Boolean(appId) && (input.trim().length > 0 || docs.some((d) => d.content.trim())) && !scanning && retryIn <= 0;

  const onSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!canSubmit) return;
    setScanning(true);
    setError(null);
    const sentDocs = docs.filter((d) => d.content.length > 0);
    const body = {
      app_id: appId,
      ...(input ? { input } : {}),
      context_docs: sentDocs.map((d, i) => ({ id: `doc-${i + 1}`, content: d.content, source_type: d.source_type, content_type: d.content_type })),
      options: { return_sanitized: true, explain: true, judge_enabled: runJudge },
    };
    try {
      const data = await apiFetch<ScanResult>("/api/playground/scan", { method: "POST", json: body });
      setResult({ data, originals: { input: input || undefined, context_docs: sentDocs.map((d) => ({ content: d.content, content_type: d.content_type })) } });
    } catch (err) {
      const de = toDisplayError(err);
      if (de.status === 429) {
        setRetryIn(de.retryAfterSeconds ?? 60);
        setError(de);
      } else {
        setError(showError(err, "Scan failed"));
      }
      setResult(null);
    } finally {
      setScanning(false);
    }
  };

  const view = React.useMemo(
    () =>
      result
        ? scanViewFromResult(result.data, {
            judgeEnabled: runJudge,
            grayZone: policy?.policy.gray_zone ?? null,
          })
        : null,
    // The view reflects the options used for the scan that produced it.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [result, policy],
  );

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,5fr)_minmax(0,7fr)]">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Scan request</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4" aria-busy={scanning}>
            <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label htmlFor="pg-app">App (policy)</Label>
                <Select id="pg-app" value={appId} onChange={(e) => setAppId(e.target.value)} disabled={!apps?.length}>
                  {!apps ? <option value="">Loading apps…</option> : null}
                  {apps && !apps.length ? <option value="">No apps available</option> : null}
                  {apps?.map((a) => (
                    <option key={a.app_id} value={a.app_id}>
                      {a.name} ({a.app_id}){a.status !== "active" ? " — disabled" : ""}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label htmlFor="pg-preset">Presets</Label>
                <Select id="pg-preset" ref={presetRef} value={presetId} onChange={(e) => applyPreset(e.target.value)}>
                  <option value="">Choose an example…</option>
                  {PRESETS.map((p) => (
                    <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                      {p.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
                {presetId ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === presetId)?.description}</p> : null}
              </div>
            </div>
            <ApiErrorMessage error={appsError} title="Could not load apps" />

            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="pg-input">User input</Label>
              <Textarea id="pg-input" value={input} onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)} rows={4} placeholder="Type the end-user message…" />
            </div>

            <fieldset className="space-y-3">
              <legend className="text-sm font-medium">Context documents</legend>
              {docs.length === 0 ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No documents. Add web pages, emails, files or RAG chunks to scan them as untrusted content.</p> : null}
              {docs.map((d, i) => (
                <div key={d.key} className="space-y-2 rounded-md border p-3">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor={`doc-src-${d.key}`}>Document {i + 1} source_type</Label>
                      <Select id={`doc-src-${d.key}`} value={d.source_type} onChange={(e) => updateDoc(d.key, { source_type: e.target.value as PresetDoc["source_type"] })} className="w-32">
                        {SOURCE_TYPES.map((s) => (
                          <option key={s} value={s}>
                            {s}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor={`doc-ct-${d.key}`}>Document {i + 1} content_type</Label>
                      <Select id={`doc-ct-${d.key}`} value={d.content_type} onChange={(e) => updateDoc(d.key, { content_type: e.target.value as PresetDoc["content_type"] })} className="w-32">
                        {CONTENT_TYPES.map((s) => (
                          <option key={s} value={s}>
                            {s}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </Select>
                    </div>
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => removeDoc(d.key)} className="ml-auto">
                      Remove document {i + 1}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor={`doc-content-${d.key}`}>Document {i + 1} content</Label>
                    <Textarea id={`doc-content-${d.key}`} value={d.content} onChange={(e) => updateDoc(d.key, { content: e.target.value })} rows={5} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={addDoc} disabled={docs.length >= 20}>
                Add context document
              </Button>
            </fieldset>

            <Switch checked={runJudge} onCheckedChange={setRunJudge} label="Run judge (overrides judge_enabled for this scan only)" />

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Button type="submit" disabled={!canSubmit}>
                {scanning ? <Spinner label="Scanning" /> : null}
                {scanning ? "Scanning…" : "Scan"}
              </Button>
              {appId && policy ? (
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Policy v{policy.policy_version} · mode {policy.policy.mode}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <section aria-label="Scan result" aria-live="polite">
        {error?.status === 429 ? (
          <Alert tone="warning" title="Rate limited">
            {retryIn > 0 ? `Rate limit reached — try again in ${retryIn} s` : "Rate limit reached — you can try again now."}
            {error.requestId ? <span className="mt-1 block text-xs">Request ID: {error.requestId}</span> : null}
          </Alert>
        ) : error?.status === 413 ? (
          <Alert tone="error" title="Request too large">
            <p>{error.message}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs">Limits: total request ≤ 64 KB, at most 20 context documents, each segment ≤ 32 KB.</p>
            {error.requestId ? <p className="mt-1 text-xs">Request ID: {error.requestId}</p> : null}
          </Alert>
        ) : (
          <ApiErrorMessage error={error} title="Scan failed" />
        )}

        {scanning ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <Spinner label="Scanning" /> Running the three layers…
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {!scanning && view && result ? (
          <ScanResultPanel view={view} raw={result.data} thresholds={policy?.policy.thresholds ?? null} originals={result.originals} />
        ) : null}

        {!scanning && !result && !error ? (
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>How a scan works</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-2 text-sm">
              <ol className="list-decimal space-y-1 pl-5">
                <li>
                  <strong>L1 heuristics</strong> — versioned regex rules for overrides, role hijacks, prompt extraction, exfiltration, hidden HTML and invisible
                  Unicode.
                </li>
                <li>
                  <strong>L2 classifier</strong> — an ONNX prompt-injection model scores every chunk of every segment.
                </li>
                <li>
                  <strong>L3 judge</strong> — an LLM judge reviews only gray-zone segments, within the per-request budget.
                </li>
              </ol>
              <p>
                Scores are fused into a risk score, and the policy maps it to ALLOW, FLAG, SANITIZE or BLOCK.{" "}
                <Button variant="link" className="h-auto p-0" onClick={() => presetRef.current?.focus()}>
                  Try one of the presets
                </Button>
                .
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ) : null}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

// Re-exported for tests that want the same input ids.
export const PLAYGROUND_INPUT_ID = "pg-input";
export { Input };

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { serverGet } from "@/lib/server-api";
import { AppListResponseSchema, VerdictListResponseSchema } from "@/lib/schemas";
import { filtersToApiQuery, filtersToSearch, parseFilters } from "@/lib/verdict-filters";
import { VerdictsClient } from "./verdicts-client";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Verdicts" };

// FE-19: the first page of verdicts is rendered on the server for a fast LCP.
export default async function VerdictsPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>> }) {
  const filters = parseFilters(await searchParams);
  const [list, apps] = await Promise.all([
    serverGet("/verdicts", VerdictListResponseSchema, filtersToApiQuery(filters)),
    serverGet("/apps", AppListResponseSchema),
  ]);
  const search = filtersToSearch(filters);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Verdicts" description="Recent firewall decisions. Snippets are PII-redacted; raw input is never stored." />
      <VerdictsClient
        key={search}
        filters={filters}
        initial={list.ok ? list.data : { items: [], next_cursor: null }}
        initialError={list.ok ? null : list.error}
        apps={apps.ok ? apps.data.apps.map((a) => ({ app_id: a.app_id, name: a.name })) : []}
      />
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createColumnHelper, flexRender, getCoreRowModel, useReactTable } from "@tanstack/react-table";
import { ActionBadge } from "@/components/action-badge";
import { ApiErrorMessage, useErrorToast, type DisplayError } from "@/components/api-error";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input, Label, Select } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Spinner, TableScroll, td, th } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { fmtDateTime, fmtMs, fmtRelative, fmtScore, totalLatency } from "@/lib/format";
import type { VerdictListResponse, VerdictSummary } from "@/lib/schemas";
import { ACTIONS, ORIGINS, filtersToApiQuery, filtersToSearch, type Range, type VerdictFilters } from "@/lib/verdict-filters";

const col = createColumnHelper<VerdictSummary>();

const columns = [
  col.accessor("created_at", {
    header: "Time",
    cell: (c) => (
      <Link href={`/verdicts/${encodeURIComponent(c.row.original.verdict_id)}`} className="text-primary underline-offset-2 hover:underline">
        <time dateTime={c.getValue()} title={fmtRelative(c.getValue())} suppressHydrationWarning>
          {fmtDateTime(c.getValue())}
        </time>
      </Link>
    ),
  }),
  col.accessor("app_id", { header: "App", cell: (c) => <span className="font-mono text-xs">{c.getValue()}</span> }),
  col.accessor("action", { header: "Action", cell: (c) => <ActionBadge action={c.getValue()} wouldAction={c.row.original.would_action} /> }),
  col.accessor("risk_score", { header: "Risk", cell: (c) => <span className="tabular-nums">{fmtScore(c.getValue())}</span> }),
  col.accessor("categories", {
    header: "Categories",
    cell: (c) => (
      <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
        {c.getValue().length ? c.getValue().map((cat) => <Badge key={cat} className="border-slate-400 bg-white font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-900">{cat}</Badge>) : <span className="text-muted-foreground">—</span>}
      </span>
    ),
  }),
  col.accessor("snippet", {
    header: "Snippet",
    cell: (c) => (
      <span className="block max-w-[22rem] truncate font-mono text-xs" title={c.getValue()}>
        {c.getValue().replace(/\s+/g, " ") || "—"}
      </span>
    ),
  }),
  col.accessor((r) => totalLatency(r.latency_ms ?? null), { id: "latency", header: "Latency", cell: (c) => <span className="tabular-nums">{fmtMs(c.getValue())}</span> }),
  col.accessor("degraded", {
    header: "Degraded",
    cell: (c) =>
      c.getValue() ? (
        <span title="Degraded: a layer timed out or errored">
          <span aria-hidden>⚠</span>
          <span className="sr-only">Degraded</span>
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span className="sr-only">Not degraded</span>
      ),
  }),
];

export function VerdictsClient({
  filters,
  initial,
  initialError,
  apps,
}: {
  filters: VerdictFilters;
  initial: VerdictListResponse;
  initialError: { status: number; code: string; message: string; request_id: string } | null;
  apps: { app_id: string; name: string }[];
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState<VerdictSummary[]>(initial.items);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = React.useState<string | null>(initial.next_cursor ?? null);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = React.useState(false);
  const [autoRefresh, setAutoRefresh] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(
    initialError ? { status: initialError.status, code: initialError.code, message: initialError.message, requestId: initialError.request_id } : null,
  );
  const [minRiskDraft, setMinRiskDraft] = React.useState(filters.minRisk === null ? "" : String(filters.minRisk));
  const anchorNow = React.useRef(Date.now());
  const showError = useErrorToast();

  const update = (patch: Partial<VerdictFilters>) => {
    const next = { ...filters, ...patch };
    const qs = filtersToSearch(next);
    router.replace(qs ? `${pathname}?${qs}` : pathname, { scroll: false });
  };

  const toggle = <T extends string>(list: T[], v: T): T[] => (list.includes(v) ? list.filter((x) => x !== v) : [...list, v]);

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (!cursor) return;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    try {
      const q = filtersToApiQuery(filters, anchorNow.current, cursor);
      const res = await apiFetch<VerdictListResponse>(`/api/verdicts?${q.toString()}`);
      setItems((xs) => {
        const seen = new Set(xs.map((x) => x.verdict_id));
        return [...xs, ...res.items.filter((x) => !seen.has(x.verdict_id))];
      });
      setCursor(res.next_cursor ?? null);
      setError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(showError(e, "Could not load more verdicts"));
    } finally {
      setLoadingMore(false);
    }
  };

  // Optional auto-refresh every 10 s (off by default): prepend new verdicts.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoRefresh) return;
    const tick = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await apiFetch<VerdictListResponse>(`/api/verdicts?${filtersToApiQuery(filters, Date.now()).toString()}`);
        setItems((xs) => {
          const seen = new Set(xs.map((x) => x.verdict_id));
          const fresh = res.items.filter((x) => !seen.has(x.verdict_id));
          return fresh.length ? [...fresh, ...xs] : xs;
        });
      } catch {
        // Keep showing the current list; the next tick retries.
      }
    };
    const id = window.setInterval(tick, 10_000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [autoRefresh, filters]);

  const table = useReactTable({ data: items, columns, getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(), getRowId: (r) => r.verdict_id });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <form className="grid gap-4 rounded-md border p-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4" aria-label="Verdict filters" onSubmit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="f-app">App</Label>
          <Select id="f-app" value={filters.app} onChange={(e) => update({ app: e.target.value })}>
            <option value="">All apps</option>
            {apps.map((a) => (
              <option key={a.app_id} value={a.app_id}>
                {a.name} ({a.app_id})
              </option>
            ))}
            {filters.app && !apps.some((a) => a.app_id === filters.app) ? <option value={filters.app}>{filters.app}</option> : null}
          </Select>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="f-range">Time range</Label>
          <Select id="f-range" value={filters.range} onChange={(e) => update({ range: e.target.value as Range })}>
            <option value="1h">Last 1 hour</option>
            <option value="24h">Last 24 hours</option>
            <option value="7d">Last 7 days</option>
            <option value="custom">Custom…</option>
          </Select>
          {filters.range === "custom" ? (
            <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="f-from" className="text-xs">From</Label>
                <Input id="f-from" type="datetime-local" value={filters.from} onChange={(e) => update({ from: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <Label htmlFor="f-to" className="text-xs">To</Label>
                <Input id="f-to" type="datetime-local" value={filters.to} onChange={(e) => update({ to: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="f-risk">Minimum risk (0–1)</Label>
          <Input
            id="f-risk"
            type="number"
            inputMode="decimal"
            min={0}
            max={1}
            step={0.05}
            value={minRiskDraft}
            onChange={(e) => setMinRiskDraft(e.target.value)}
            onBlur={() => {
              const v = minRiskDraft === "" ? null : Number(minRiskDraft);
              if (v === null || (Number.isFinite(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 1)) {
                if (v !== filters.minRisk) update({ minRisk: v });
              }
            }}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
            }}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3">
          <fieldset>
            <legend className="text-sm font-medium">Action</legend>
            <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {ACTIONS.map((a) => (
                <label key={a} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={filters.actions.includes(a)} onChange={() => update({ actions: toggle(filters.actions, a) })} />
                  {a.toUpperCase()}
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          </fieldset>
          <fieldset>
            <legend className="text-sm font-medium">Origin</legend>
            <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
              {ORIGINS.map((o) => (
                <label key={o} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={filters.origins.includes(o)} onChange={() => update({ origins: toggle(filters.origins, o) })} />
                  {o}
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          </fieldset>
        </div>
      </form>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
          {items.length} verdict{items.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} shown
        </p>
        <Switch checked={autoRefresh} onCheckedChange={setAutoRefresh} label="Auto-refresh every 10 s" />
      </div>

      <ApiErrorMessage error={error} title="Could not load verdicts" />

      <TableScroll label="Verdicts table">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[960px] border-collapse">
          <thead>
            {table.getHeaderGroups().map((hg) => (
              <tr key={hg.id}>
                {hg.headers.map((h) => (
                  <th key={h.id} scope="col" className={th}>
                    {flexRender(h.column.columnDef.header, h.getContext())}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
              <tr key={row.id} className="hover:bg-muted/50" data-testid="verdict-row">
                {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => (
                  <td key={cell.id} className={td}>
                    {flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}
                  </td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
            {items.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={columns.length} className={`${td} py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground`}>
                  No verdicts match these filters.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : null}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </TableScroll>

      {cursor ? (
        <div className="flex justify-center">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={loadMore} disabled={loadingMore}>
            {loadingMore ? <Spinner label="Loading more" /> : null}
            Load more
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { ApiErrorMessage } from "@/components/api-error";
import { PlainText } from "@/components/highlighted-text";
import { ScanResultPanel } from "@/components/scan-result-panel";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Alert, PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { fmtDateTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { scanViewFromVerdict } from "@/lib/scan-view";
import { PolicyResponseSchema, VerdictDetailSchema } from "@/lib/schemas";
import { serverGet } from "@/lib/server-api";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Verdict" };

export default async function VerdictDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/.test(id)) notFound();
  const res = await serverGet(`/verdicts/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, VerdictDetailSchema);
  if (!res.ok) {
    if (res.error.status === 404) notFound();
    return (
      <>
        <PageHeader title="Verdict" />
        <ApiErrorMessage
          error={{ status: res.error.status, code: res.error.code, message: res.error.message, requestId: res.error.request_id }}
          title="Could not load verdict"
        />
      </>
    );
  }
  const v = res.data;
  const policy = await serverGet(`/apps/${encodeURIComponent(v.app_id)}/policy`, PolicyResponseSchema);
  const view = scanViewFromVerdict(v);
  const versions: [string, unknown][] = [
    ["Core", v.versions.core],
    ["Rules", v.versions.rules],
    ["Classifier", v.versions.classifier],
    ["Judge", v.versions.judge],
    ["Policy", v.versions.policy],
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title="Verdict"
        description={`${v.verdict_id} · ${v.app_id} · ${fmtDateTime(v.created_at)}${v.origin ? ` · origin ${v.origin}` : ""}`}
        actions={
          <Link href="/verdicts" className="text-sm text-primary underline">
            Back to verdicts
          </Link>
        }
      />
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,4fr)_minmax(0,8fr)]">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Input</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-3">
              <Alert tone="info">Full input is not retained by design (privacy policy P1).</Alert>
              <div>
                <h3 className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Snippet (redacted)</h3>
                <PlainText text={v.snippet || "—"} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">input_hash</h3>
                <code className="block break-all rounded bg-muted p-2 text-xs">{v.input_hash ?? "—"}</code>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>Versions</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-sm">
                {versions.map(([k, val]) => (
                  <React.Fragment key={k}>
                    <dt className="text-muted-foreground">{k}</dt>
                    <dd className="break-all font-mono text-xs">{val === undefined || val === null ? "—" : String(val)}</dd>
                  </React.Fragment>
                ))}
              </dl>
              <Link href={`/apps/${encodeURIComponent(v.app_id)}`} className="mt-3 inline-block text-sm text-primary underline">
                View {v.app_id} policy
              </Link>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
        <ScanResultPanel view={view} raw={v} thresholds={policy.ok ? policy.data.policy.thresholds : null} />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { TableScroll, td, th } from "@/components/ui/misc";

export interface TableColumn<T> {
  key: string;
  header: string;
  render: (row: T) => React.ReactNode;
}

/** Chart with an accessible data-table alternative ("View as table", FE-10). */
export function ChartCard<T>({
  title,
  description,
  rows,
  columns,
  children,
  emptyText = "No data for this period.",
}: {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  rows: T[];
  columns: TableColumn<T>[];
  children: React.ReactNode;
  emptyText?: string;
}) {
  const [asTable, setAsTable] = React.useState(false);
  const titleId = React.useId();
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="flex-row items-start justify-between gap-2 space-y-0">
        <div>
          <CardTitle id={titleId}>{title}</CardTitle>
          {description ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{description}</p> : null}
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" aria-pressed={asTable} onClick={() => setAsTable((v) => !v)}>
          {asTable ? "View as chart" : "View as table"}
        </Button>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">{emptyText}</p>
        ) : asTable ? (
          <TableScroll label={`${title} data`}>
            <table className="w-full border-collapse">
              <caption className="sr-only">{title}</caption>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {columns.map((c) => (
                    <th key={c.key} scope="col" className={th}>
                      {c.header}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((r, i) => (
                  <tr key={i}>
                    {columns.map((c) => (
                      <td key={c.key} className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>
                        {c.render(r)}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </TableScroll>
        ) : (
          <div role="img" aria-labelledby={titleId} className="h-64 w-full">
            {children}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, Legend, Line, LineChart, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
import { ACTION_COLORS } from "@/components/action-badge";
import { ApiErrorMessage, toDisplayError, type DisplayError } from "@/components/api-error";
import { ChartCard } from "@/components/chart-card";
import { useApps } from "@/components/use-apps";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Label, Select } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { fmtMs, fmtPct } from "@/lib/format";
import type { StatsBucket, StatsResponse } from "@/lib/schemas";

const RANGES = {
  "24h": { label: "Last 24 hours", ms: 86_400_000, granularity: "hour" },
  "7d": { label: "Last 7 days", ms: 7 * 86_400_000, granularity: "day" },
  "30d": { label: "Last 30 days", ms: 30 * 86_400_000, granularity: "day" },
} as const;
type RangeKey = keyof typeof RANGES;

const rate = (num: number, den: number) => (den > 0 ? num / den : null);

function label(ts: string, granularity: "hour" | "day") {
  const d = new Date(ts);
  if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return ts;
  return granularity === "hour"
    ? d.toLocaleString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "2-digit" })
    : d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}

interface Row extends StatsBucket {
  label: string;
  block_rate: number | null;
  judge_rate: number | null;
}

export function AnalyticsClient() {
  const { apps } = useApps();
  const [app, setApp] = React.useState("");
  const [range, setRange] = React.useState<RangeKey>("24h");
  const [data, setData] = React.useState<StatsResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const now = Date.now();
    const cfg = RANGES[range];
    const q = new URLSearchParams({ from: new Date(now - cfg.ms).toISOString(), to: new Date(now).toISOString(), granularity: cfg.granularity });
    if (app) q.set("app_id", app);
    setLoading(true);
    apiFetch<StatsResponse>(`/api/stats?${q.toString()}`)
      .then((d) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setData(d);
        setError(null);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (!cancelled) setError(toDisplayError(e));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [app, range]);

  const granularity = data?.granularity ?? RANGES[range].granularity;
  const rows: Row[] = React.useMemo(
    () =>
      (data?.buckets ?? []).map((b) => ({
        ...b,
        label: label(b.ts, granularity),
        block_rate: rate(b.block, b.total),
        judge_rate: rate(b.judge_calls, b.total),
      })),
    [data, granularity],
  );

  const totals = React.useMemo(() => {
    const sum = (k: "total" | "block" | "flag" | "degraded" | "judge_calls") => rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r[k] ?? 0), 0);
    const t = data?.totals ?? {};
    const total = t.total ?? sum("total");
    const p95 = t.p95_ms ?? (rows.length ? Math.max(...rows.map((r) => r.p95_ms ?? 0)) : null);
    return {
      total,
      block: rate(t.block ?? sum("block"), total),
      flag: rate(t.flag ?? sum("flag"), total),
      judge: rate(t.judge_calls ?? sum("judge_calls"), total),
      degraded: rate(t.degraded ?? sum("degraded"), total),
      p95: p95 || null,
    };
  }, [data, rows]);

  const categories = React.useMemo(() => {
    const c = data?.categories ?? [];
    const list = Array.isArray(c) ? c : Object.entries(c).map(([category, count]) => ({ category, count }));
    return [...list].sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count).slice(0, 10);
  }, [data]);

  const kpis: [string, string][] = [
    ["Total requests", totals.total.toLocaleString()],
    ["Block rate", fmtPct(totals.block)],
    ["Flag rate", fmtPct(totals.flag)],
    ["Judge escalation rate", fmtPct(totals.judge)],
    ["p95 latency", fmtMs(totals.p95)],
    ["Degraded rate", fmtPct(totals.degraded)],
  ];

  const axis = { fontSize: 11, fill: "#334155" };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="an-app">App</Label>
          <Select id="an-app" value={app} onChange={(e) => setApp(e.target.value)} className="w-64">
            <option value="">All apps</option>
            {apps?.map((a) => (
              <option key={a.app_id} value={a.app_id}>
                {a.name} ({a.app_id})
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="an-range">Time range</Label>
          <Select id="an-range" value={range} onChange={(e) => setRange(e.target.value as RangeKey)} className="w-48">
            {(Object.keys(RANGES) as RangeKey[]).map((k) => (
              <option key={k} value={k}>
                {RANGES[k].label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        {loading ? <Spinner className="self-end pb-2" label="Loading analytics" /> : null}
      </div>

      <ApiErrorMessage error={error} title="Could not load analytics" />

      <section aria-label="Key metrics" className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6">
        {kpis.map(([k, v]) => (
          <Card key={k}>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{k}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{v}</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </section>

      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <ChartCard
          title="Requests by action"
          description={`Stacked by ${granularity}`}
          rows={rows}
          columns={[
            { key: "t", header: "Period", render: (r) => r.label },
            { key: "allow", header: "Allow", render: (r) => r.allow },
            { key: "flag", header: "Flag", render: (r) => r.flag },
            { key: "sanitize", header: "Sanitize", render: (r) => r.sanitize },
            { key: "block", header: "Block", render: (r) => r.block },
          ]}
        >
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <BarChart data={rows}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={axis} />
              <YAxis tick={axis} allowDecimals={false} />
              <Tooltip />
              <Legend />
              <Bar dataKey="allow" name="ALLOW" stackId="a" fill={ACTION_COLORS.allow} />
              <Bar dataKey="flag" name="FLAG" stackId="a" fill={ACTION_COLORS.flag} />
              <Bar dataKey="sanitize" name="SANITIZE" stackId="a" fill={ACTION_COLORS.sanitize} />
              <Bar dataKey="block" name="BLOCK" stackId="a" fill={ACTION_COLORS.block} />
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </ChartCard>

        <ChartCard
          title="Block rate over time"
          rows={rows}
          columns={[
            { key: "t", header: "Period", render: (r) => r.label },
            { key: "br", header: "Block rate", render: (r) => fmtPct(r.block_rate) },
          ]}
        >
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <LineChart data={rows}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={axis} />
              <YAxis tick={axis} tickFormatter={(v: number) => `${Math.round(v * 100)}%`} domain={[0, "auto"]} />
              <Tooltip formatter={(v: number) => fmtPct(v)} />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="block_rate" name="Block rate" stroke={ACTION_COLORS.block} strokeWidth={2} dot={false} connectNulls />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </ChartCard>

        <ChartCard
          title="Top finding categories"
          rows={categories}
          columns={[
            { key: "c", header: "Category", render: (r) => r.category },
            { key: "n", header: "Count", render: (r) => r.count },
          ]}
        >
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <BarChart data={categories} layout="vertical" margin={{ left: 24 }}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis type="number" tick={axis} allowDecimals={false} />
              <YAxis type="category" dataKey="category" tick={axis} width={140} />
              <Tooltip />
              <Bar dataKey="count" name="Findings" fill="#334155" />
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </ChartCard>

        <ChartCard
          title="Latency p50 / p95"
          rows={rows}
          columns={[
            { key: "t", header: "Period", render: (r) => r.label },
            { key: "p50", header: "p50", render: (r) => fmtMs(r.p50_ms) },
            { key: "p95", header: "p95", render: (r) => fmtMs(r.p95_ms) },
          ]}
        >
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <LineChart data={rows}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={axis} />
              <YAxis tick={axis} unit=" ms" />
              <Tooltip formatter={(v: number) => fmtMs(v)} />
              <Legend />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="p50_ms" name="p50" stroke="#0f766e" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} connectNulls />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="p95_ms" name="p95" stroke="#7c3aed" strokeWidth={2} strokeDasharray="5 3" dot={false} connectNulls />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </ChartCard>

        <ChartCard
          title="Judge escalation rate over time"
          rows={rows}
          columns={[
            { key: "t", header: "Period", render: (r) => r.label },
            { key: "jr", header: "Judge escalation rate", render: (r) => fmtPct(r.judge_rate) },
          ]}
        >
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <LineChart data={rows}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey="label" tick={axis} />
              <YAxis tick={axis} tickFormatter={(v: number) => `${Math.round(v * 100)}%`} domain={[0, "auto"]} />
              <Tooltip formatter={(v: number) => fmtPct(v)} />
              <Line type="monotone" dataKey="judge_rate" name="Judge escalation rate" stroke="#1d4ed8" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} connectNulls />
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </ChartCard>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { CopyButton } from "@/components/copy-button";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Alert } from "@/components/ui/misc";

/**
 * Shows a freshly issued API key exactly once (FE-11, AC-FE-7). The parent keeps the key only in
 * component state and clears it in onClose; it is never written to storage, the URL or the router cache.
 */
export function KeyRevealDialog({ apiKey, appId, note, onClose }: { apiKey: string | null; appId: string; note?: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  return (
    <Dialog
      open={apiKey !== null}
      onClose={onClose}
      dismissible={false}
      title={`API key for ${appId}`}
      description="Copy the key now and store it in your secret manager."
      footer={<Button onClick={onClose}>I have stored the key — close</Button>}
    >
      {apiKey ? (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <Alert tone="warning" title="This key will not be shown again." />
          <code data-testid="api-key-value" className="block break-all rounded-md border bg-muted p-3 font-mono text-sm">
            {apiKey}
          </code>
          <CopyButton value={apiKey} label="Copy key" />
          {note ? <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{note}</p> : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </Dialog>
  );
}
