"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { createColumnHelper, flexRender, getCoreRowModel, useReactTable, type ColumnDef } from "@tanstack/react-table";
import { ApiErrorMessage, useErrorToast, type DisplayError } from "@/components/api-error";
import { KeyRevealDialog } from "@/components/key-reveal-dialog";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { FieldError, Input, Label } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Alert, Spinner, TableScroll, td, th } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { TagInput } from "@/components/ui/tag-input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/toast";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { fmtDateTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { DomainSchema } from "@/lib/policy";
import { CreateAppRequestSchema, type App } from "@/lib/schemas";

const col = createColumnHelper<App>();

function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  return status === "active" ? (
    <Badge className="border-green-700 bg-green-50 text-green-900">● active</Badge>
  ) : (
    <Badge className="border-slate-500 bg-slate-100 text-slate-800">○ {status}</Badge>
  );
}

type Pending = { kind: "rotate" | "disable" | "enable"; app: App } | null;

export function AppsClient({
  isAdmin,
  initialApps,
  initialError,
}: {
  isAdmin: boolean;
  initialApps: App[];
  initialError: { status: number; code: string; message: string; request_id: string } | null;
}) {
  const [apps, setApps] = React.useState<App[]>(initialApps);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(
    initialError ? { status: initialError.status, code: initialError.code, message: initialError.message, requestId: initialError.request_id } : null,
  );
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState<Pending>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  // One-time key display. Cleared on close (AC-FE-7).
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = React.useState<{ appId: string; key: string; note?: string } | null>(null);
  const showError = useErrorToast();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  const reload = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch<{ apps: App[] }>("/api/apps");
      setApps(res.apps);
      setError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(showError(e, "Could not load apps"));
    }
  }, [showError]);

  const runPending = async () => {
    if (!pending) return;
    setBusy(true);
    const { kind, app } = pending;
    try {
      if (kind === "rotate") {
        const res = await apiFetch<{ api_key: string; prev_key_expires_at?: string }>(`/api/apps/${encodeURIComponent(app.app_id)}/rotate-key`, { method: "POST" });
        setPending(null);
        setRevealed({
          appId: app.app_id,
          key: res.api_key,
          note: res.prev_key_expires_at ? `The previous key stays valid until ${fmtDateTime(res.prev_key_expires_at)}.` : "The previous key stays valid for the grace period (24 h).",
        });
      } else {
        await apiFetch(`/api/apps/${encodeURIComponent(app.app_id)}`, { method: "PATCH", json: { status: kind === "disable" ? "disabled" : "active" } });
        setPending(null);
        toast({ tone: "success", title: kind === "disable" ? `Disabled ${app.app_id}` : `Enabled ${app.app_id}` });
      }
      await reload();
    } catch (e) {
      showError(e, "Action failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const columns = React.useMemo(() => {
    const base: ColumnDef<App, any>[] = [ // eslint-disable-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
      col.accessor("app_id", {
        header: "App ID",
        cell: (c) => (
          <Link href={`/apps/${encodeURIComponent(c.getValue())}`} className="font-mono text-xs text-primary underline-offset-2 hover:underline">
            {c.getValue()}
          </Link>
        ),
      }),
      col.accessor("name", { header: "Name" }),
      col.accessor("status", { header: "Status", cell: (c) => <StatusBadge status={c.getValue()} /> }),
      col.accessor("key_prefix", { header: "Key prefix", cell: (c) => <code className="text-xs">{c.getValue() ? `${c.getValue()}…` : "—"}</code> }),
      col.accessor((a) => a.mode ?? a.policy?.mode, { id: "mode", header: "Mode", cell: (c) => c.getValue() ?? "—" }),
      col.accessor("policy_version", { header: "Policy version", cell: (c) => c.getValue() ?? "—" }),
      col.accessor("updated_at", {
        header: "Last updated",
        cell: (c) => (
          <time dateTime={c.getValue()} suppressHydrationWarning>
            {fmtDateTime(c.getValue())}
          </time>
        ),
      }),
    ];
    if (isAdmin) {
      base.push(
        col.display({
          id: "actions",
          header: "Actions",
          cell: (c) => {
            const app = c.row.original;
            return (
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setPending({ kind: "rotate", app })} disabled={app.status !== "active"}>
                  Rotate key
                </Button>
                {app.status === "active" ? (
                  <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" onClick={() => setPending({ kind: "disable", app })}>
                    Disable app
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => setPending({ kind: "enable", app })}>
                    Enable app
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          },
        }),
      );
    }
    return base;
  }, [isAdmin]);

  const table = useReactTable({ data: apps, columns, getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(), getRowId: (a) => a.app_id });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {isAdmin ? (
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <Button onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)}>Create app</Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">You have read-only access (analyst).</p>
      )}

      <ApiErrorMessage error={error} title="Could not load apps" />

      <TableScroll label="Apps table">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] border-collapse">
          <thead>
            {table.getHeaderGroups().map((hg) => (
              <tr key={hg.id}>
                {hg.headers.map((h) => (
                  <th key={h.id} scope="col" className={th}>
                    {flexRender(h.column.columnDef.header, h.getContext())}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
              <tr key={row.id} data-testid="app-row">
                {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => (
                  <td key={cell.id} className={td}>
                    {flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}
                  </td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
            {apps.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={columns.length} className={`${td} py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground`}>
                  No apps yet.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : null}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </TableScroll>

      {isAdmin ? (
        <CreateAppDialog
          open={createOpen}
          onClose={() => setCreateOpen(false)}
          onCreated={(app, key) => {
            setCreateOpen(false);
            setApps((xs) => [app, ...xs.filter((x) => x.app_id !== app.app_id)]);
            setRevealed({ appId: app.app_id, key });
          }}
        />
      ) : null}

      <Dialog
        open={pending !== null}
        onClose={() => !busy && setPending(null)}
        title={
          pending?.kind === "rotate" ? `Rotate key for ${pending.app.app_id}?` : pending?.kind === "disable" ? `Disable ${pending?.app.app_id}?` : `Enable ${pending?.app.app_id}?`
        }
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setPending(null)} disabled={busy}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant={pending?.kind === "disable" ? "destructive" : "default"} onClick={runPending} disabled={busy}>
              {busy ? <Spinner label="Working" /> : null}
              {pending?.kind === "rotate" ? "Rotate key" : pending?.kind === "disable" ? "Disable app" : "Enable app"}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {pending?.kind === "rotate" ? (
          <p className="text-sm">
            A new API key will be generated and shown once. The current key keeps working for a <strong>24-hour grace period</strong>, then requests that use it
            are rejected with 401.
          </p>
        ) : pending?.kind === "disable" ? (
          <p className="text-sm">Requests with this app&apos;s key will be rejected until it is enabled again.</p>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-sm">The app&apos;s key will be accepted again.</p>
        )}
      </Dialog>

      <KeyRevealDialog apiKey={revealed?.key ?? null} appId={revealed?.appId ?? ""} note={revealed?.note} onClose={() => setRevealed(null)} />
    </div>
  );
}

type CreateErrors = Partial<Record<"app_id" | "name" | "chat_model_id" | "allowed_link_domains" | "_", string[]>>;

function CreateAppDialog({ open, onClose, onCreated }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onCreated: (app: App, key: string) => void }) {
  const [appId, setAppId] = React.useState("");
  const [name, setName] = React.useState("");
  const [model, setModel] = React.useState("");
  const [domains, setDomains] = React.useState<string[]>([]);
  const [errors, setErrors] = React.useState<CreateErrors>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [serverError, setServerError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(null);
  const showError = useErrorToast();

  const reset = () => {
    setAppId("");
    setName("");
    setModel("");
    setDomains([]);
    setErrors({});
    setServerError(null);
  };

  const submit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const parsed = CreateAppRequestSchema.safeParse({ app_id: appId, name, chat_model_id: model, allowed_link_domains: domains });
    if (!parsed.success) {
      const errs: CreateErrors = {};
      for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
        const k = (String(issue.path[0] ?? "_") as keyof CreateErrors) ?? "_";
        (errs[k] ??= []).push(issue.message);
      }
      setErrors(errs);
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch<{ app: App; api_key: string }>("/api/apps", { method: "POST", json: parsed.data });
      reset();
      onCreated(res.app, res.api_key);
    } catch (err) {
      setServerError(showError(err, "Could not create app"));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onClose={() => {
        if (!busy) {
          reset();
          onClose();
        }
      }}
      title="Create app"
      description="The API key is generated by the server and shown once."
    >
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="ca-id">App ID</Label>
          <Input
            id="ca-id"
            value={appId}
            onChange={(e) => setAppId(e.target.value.toLowerCase())}
            placeholder="support-bot"
            aria-invalid={errors.app_id ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={errors.app_id ? "ca-id-err" : "ca-id-hint"}
            autoComplete="off"
          />
          <p id="ca-id-hint" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            3–40 characters: a–z, 0–9 and -
          </p>
          <FieldError id="ca-id-err" messages={errors.app_id} />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="ca-name">Name</Label>
          <Input id="ca-name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} aria-invalid={errors.name ? true : undefined} aria-describedby={errors.name ? "ca-name-err" : undefined} />
          <FieldError id="ca-name-err" messages={errors.name} />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="ca-model">Chat model ID (Bedrock)</Label>
          <Input
            id="ca-model"
            value={model}
            onChange={(e) => setModel(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. a Bedrock model or inference-profile ID"
            aria-invalid={errors.chat_model_id ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={errors.chat_model_id ? "ca-model-err" : undefined}
          />
          <FieldError id="ca-model-err" messages={errors.chat_model_id} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <TagInput
            id="ca-domains"
            label="Allowed link domains"
            values={domains}
            onChange={setDomains}
            placeholder="example.com, press Enter"
            validate={(v) => (DomainSchema.safeParse(v).success ? null : "Enter a domain such as example.com")}
          />
          <FieldError id="ca-domains-err" messages={errors.allowed_link_domains} />
        </div>
        <ApiErrorMessage error={serverError} title="Could not create app" />
        {Object.keys(errors).length ? <Alert tone="error">Fix the highlighted fields.</Alert> : null}
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              reset();
              onClose();
            }}
            disabled={busy}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? <Spinner label="Creating" /> : null}
            Create
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { auth } from "@/auth";
import { ApiErrorMessage } from "@/components/api-error";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { AppListResponseSchema, PolicyResponseSchema } from "@/lib/schemas";
import { serverGet } from "@/lib/server-api";
import { AppDetailClient } from "./app-detail-client";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "App" };

export default async function AppDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]{3,40}$/.test(id)) notFound();
  const session = await auth();
  const isAdmin = session?.user.role === "admin";
  const [apps, policy] = await Promise.all([
    serverGet("/apps", AppListResponseSchema),
    serverGet(`/apps/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/policy`, PolicyResponseSchema),
  ]);
  const app = apps.ok ? apps.data.apps.find((a) => a.app_id === id) : undefined;
  if (apps.ok && !app) notFound();

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        title={app?.name ?? id}
        description={`App ID ${id}`}
        actions={
          <Link href="/apps" className="text-sm text-primary underline">
            Back to apps
          </Link>
        }
      />
      {!apps.ok ? (
        <ApiErrorMessage
          error={{ status: apps.error.status, code: apps.error.code, message: apps.error.message, requestId: apps.error.request_id }}
          title="Could not load app"
          className="mb-4"
        />
      ) : null}
      <AppDetailClient
        appId={id}
        app={app ?? null}
        isAdmin={isAdmin}
        initialPolicy={policy.ok ? policy.data : null}
        initialPolicyError={policy.ok ? null : policy.error}
      />
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { ApiErrorMessage, toDisplayError, useErrorToast, type DisplayError } from "@/components/api-error";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { FieldError, Input, Label, Select } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Alert, Spinner, TableScroll, td, th } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { TagInput } from "@/components/ui/tag-input";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/toast";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { fmtDateTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { DomainSchema, diffObjects, validatePolicy, type FieldErrors, type Policy } from "@/lib/policy";
import type { PolicyResponse } from "@/lib/schemas";

interface Draft {
  policy: Policy;
  allowed_link_domains: string[];
}

function toDraft(p: PolicyResponse, fallbackDomains: string[]): Draft {
  return { policy: structuredClone(p.policy), allowed_link_domains: [...(p.allowed_link_domains ?? fallbackDomains)] };
}

function errId(field: string) {
  return `pe-${field.replace(/\./g, "-")}-err`;
}

function UnitField({
  field,
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  errors,
  disabled,
}: {
  field: string;
  label: string;
  value: number;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
  errors: FieldErrors;
  disabled: boolean;
}) {
  const id = `pe-${field.replace(/\./g, "-")}`;
  const msgs = errors[field];
  const invalid = msgs?.length ? true : undefined;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <Label htmlFor={id}>{label}</Label>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <input
          type="range"
          min={0}
          max={1}
          step={0.01}
          value={Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-label={`${label} slider`}
          aria-invalid={invalid}
          aria-describedby={invalid ? errId(field) : undefined}
          className="h-2 flex-1 accent-primary"
        />
        <Input
          id={id}
          type="number"
          min={0}
          max={1}
          step={0.01}
          inputMode="decimal"
          value={Number.isFinite(value) ? value : ""}
          onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value === "" ? Number.NaN : Number(e.target.value))}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-invalid={invalid}
          aria-describedby={invalid ? errId(field) : undefined}
          className="w-24"
          data-testid={`input-${field}`}
        />
      </div>
      <FieldError id={errId(field)} messages={msgs} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function PolicyEditor({
  appId,
  isAdmin,
  initial,
  initialError,
  fallbackDomains,
}: {
  appId: string;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  initial: PolicyResponse | null;
  initialError: { status: number; code: string; message: string; request_id: string } | null;
  fallbackDomains: string[];
}) {
  const [base, setBase] = React.useState<PolicyResponse | null>(initial);
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState<Draft | null>(initial ? toDraft(initial, fallbackDomains) : null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(
    initialError ? { status: initialError.status, code: initialError.code, message: initialError.message, requestId: initialError.request_id } : null,
  );
  const [reviewOpen, setReviewOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = React.useState(false);
  const [conflict, setConflict] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(null);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(null);
  const [reloading, setReloading] = React.useState(false);
  const showError = useErrorToast();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const readOnly = !isAdmin;

  const reload = async () => {
    setReloading(true);
    try {
      const p = await apiFetch<PolicyResponse>(`/api/apps/${encodeURIComponent(appId)}/policy`);
      setBase(p);
      setDraft(toDraft(p, fallbackDomains));
      setConflict(null);
      setSaveError(null);
      setLoadError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setLoadError(showError(e, "Could not load policy"));
    } finally {
      setReloading(false);
    }
  };

  const validation = React.useMemo(() => (draft ? validatePolicy(draft.policy) : null), [draft]);
  const errors: FieldErrors = validation && !validation.ok ? validation.errors : {};
  const baseDraft = React.useMemo(() => (base ? toDraft(base, fallbackDomains) : null), [base, fallbackDomains]);
  const diff = React.useMemo(() => (baseDraft && draft ? diffObjects(baseDraft, draft) : []), [baseDraft, draft]);
  const invalid = Boolean(validation && !validation.ok);

  if (!draft || !base) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <ApiErrorMessage error={loadError} title="Could not load policy" />
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={reload} disabled={reloading}>
          {reloading ? <Spinner label="Loading" /> : null}
          Retry
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const set = (fn: (d: Draft) => void) =>
    setDraft((d) => {
      if (!d) return d;
      const next = structuredClone(d);
      fn(next);
      return next;
    });

  const save = async () => {
    if (!validation?.ok) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveError(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch<PolicyResponse>(`/api/apps/${encodeURIComponent(appId)}/policy`, {
        method: "PUT",
        json: { policy: validation.policy, policy_version: base.policy_version, allowed_link_domains: draft.allowed_link_domains },
      });
      setBase(res);
      setDraft(toDraft(res, draft.allowed_link_domains));
      setReviewOpen(false);
      toast({ tone: "success", title: `Policy saved (version ${res.policy_version})`, description: "It takes effect within 60 s." });
    } catch (e) {
      const err = toDisplayError(e);
      setReviewOpen(false);
      if (err.status === 409) {
        setConflict(err);
      } else {
        setSaveError(showError(e, "Could not save policy"));
      }
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const p = draft.policy;
  const tagValidate = (v: string) => (v.length > 200 ? "Phrases must be ≤ 200 characters" : null);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Policy version <strong>{base.policy_version}</strong>
          {base.updated_at ? ` · updated ${fmtDateTime(base.updated_at)}` : ""}
          {base.updated_by ? ` by ${base.updated_by}` : ""}
          {readOnly ? " · read-only (analyst)" : ""}
        </p>
        {isAdmin ? (
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDraft(toDraft(base, fallbackDomains))} disabled={!diff.length || saving}>
              Discard changes
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => setReviewOpen(true)} disabled={invalid || !diff.length || saving} aria-describedby={invalid ? "pe-invalid-note" : undefined}>
              Save policy
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {invalid ? (
        <p id="pe-invalid-note" className="text-sm font-medium text-destructive">
          Fix the errors below before saving.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {conflict ? (
        <Alert tone="error" title="This policy was changed by someone else">
          <p>Your changes were not applied. Reload to get the latest version, then make your changes again.</p>
          {conflict.requestId ? <p className="mt-1 text-xs">Request ID: {conflict.requestId}</p> : null}
          <Button className="mt-2" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={reload} disabled={reloading}>
            {reloading ? <Spinner label="Reloading" /> : null}
            Reload policy
          </Button>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      <ApiErrorMessage error={saveError} title="Could not save policy" />

      {p.mode === "monitor" ? (
        <Alert tone="info" title="Monitor mode">
          Nothing is blocked in this mode: every request is allowed, and results record the action that enforce mode would have taken (would_action).
        </Alert>
      ) : null}

      <fieldset disabled={readOnly} className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <legend className="sr-only">Policy fields</legend>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Mode</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="pe-mode">Mode</Label>
              <Select id="pe-mode" value={p.mode} onChange={(e) => set((d) => void (d.policy.mode = e.target.value as Policy["mode"]))}>
                <option value="enforce">enforce</option>
                <option value="monitor">monitor</option>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="pe-fail">Fail mode</Label>
              <Select id="pe-fail" value={p.fail_mode} onChange={(e) => set((d) => void (d.policy.fail_mode = e.target.value as Policy["fail_mode"]))}>
                <option value="open">open — allow with degraded=true if the pipeline fails</option>
                <option value="closed">closed — return 503 if the pipeline fails</option>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <Switch
              checked={p.block_on_context}
              onCheckedChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.block_on_context = v))}
              disabled={readOnly}
              label="Block whole request if a context document is ≥ block threshold"
            />
            <Switch checked={p.output_checks} onCheckedChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.output_checks = v))} disabled={readOnly} label="Output checks (proxy mode)" />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Thresholds</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <UnitField field="thresholds.flag" label="Flag threshold" value={p.thresholds.flag} onChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.thresholds.flag = v))} errors={errors} disabled={readOnly} />
            <UnitField
              field="thresholds.sanitize"
              label="Sanitize threshold"
              value={p.thresholds.sanitize}
              onChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.thresholds.sanitize = v))}
              errors={errors}
              disabled={readOnly}
            />
            <UnitField field="thresholds.block" label="Block threshold" value={p.thresholds.block} onChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.thresholds.block = v))} errors={errors} disabled={readOnly} />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Must satisfy 0 &lt; flag ≤ sanitize ≤ block ≤ 1.</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Judge</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <Switch checked={p.judge_enabled} onCheckedChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.judge_enabled = v))} disabled={readOnly} label="Judge enabled" />
            <UnitField field="gray_zone.low" label="Gray zone low" value={p.gray_zone.low} onChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.gray_zone.low = v))} errors={errors} disabled={readOnly} />
            <UnitField field="gray_zone.high" label="Gray zone high" value={p.gray_zone.high} onChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.gray_zone.high = v))} errors={errors} disabled={readOnly} />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">The judge runs only when the pre-score is in [low, high). Must satisfy 0 ≤ low &lt; high ≤ 1.</p>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="pe-judge_budget">Judge budget (segments per request)</Label>
              <Input
                id="pe-judge_budget"
                type="number"
                min={0}
                max={20}
                step={1}
                value={Number.isFinite(p.judge_budget) ? p.judge_budget : ""}
                onChange={(e) => set((d) => void (d.policy.judge_budget = e.target.value === "" ? Number.NaN : Number(e.target.value)))}
                aria-invalid={errors.judge_budget ? true : undefined}
                aria-describedby={errors.judge_budget ? errId("judge_budget") : undefined}
                className="w-24"
              />
              <FieldError id={errId("judge_budget")} messages={errors.judge_budget} />
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Custom rules and links</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <TagInput
              id="pe-deny"
              label="Deny phrases"
              values={p.custom_rules.deny_phrases}
              onChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.custom_rules.deny_phrases = v))}
              disabled={readOnly}
              validate={tagValidate}
              placeholder="Type a phrase and press Enter"
            />
            <TagInput
              id="pe-allow"
              label="Allow phrases"
              values={p.custom_rules.allow_phrases}
              onChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.policy.custom_rules.allow_phrases = v))}
              disabled={readOnly}
              validate={tagValidate}
              placeholder="Type a phrase and press Enter"
            />
            <TagInput
              id="pe-domains"
              label="Allowed link domains"
              values={draft.allowed_link_domains}
              onChange={(v) => set((d) => void (d.allowed_link_domains = v))}
              disabled={readOnly}
              validate={(v) => (DomainSchema.safeParse(v).success ? null : "Enter a domain such as example.com")}
              placeholder="example.com"
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </fieldset>

      <Dialog
        open={reviewOpen}
        onClose={() => !saving && setReviewOpen(false)}
        title="Review changes"
        description={`Saving creates policy version ${base.policy_version + 1}. It is effective within 60 s.`}
        footer={
          <>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setReviewOpen(false)} disabled={saving}>
              Keep editing
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={save} disabled={saving || invalid}>
              {saving ? <Spinner label="Saving" /> : null}
              Confirm save
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <TableScroll label="Changed fields">
          <table className="w-full border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>Field</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>Current</th>
                <th scope="col" className={th}>New</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {diff.map((r) => (
                <tr key={r.field} data-testid="diff-row">
                  <th scope="row" className={`${td} text-left font-medium`}>
                    {r.label}
                  </th>
                  <td className={`${td} break-words text-red-800`}>
                    <span className="sr-only">Current: </span>
                    {r.before}
                  </td>
                  <td className={`${td} break-words text-green-800`}>
                    <span className="sr-only">New: </span>
                    {r.after}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </TableScroll>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

const STYLES: Record<string, string> = {
  queued: "border-slate-500 bg-slate-100 text-slate-900",
  running: "border-blue-700 bg-blue-50 text-blue-900",
  succeeded: "border-green-700 bg-green-50 text-green-900",
  failed: "border-red-700 bg-red-50 text-red-900",
};
const GLYPH: Record<string, string> = { queued: "…", running: "↻", succeeded: "✓", failed: "✕" };

export function RunStatus({ status }: { status: string }) {
  return (
    <Badge className={STYLES[status] ?? STYLES.queued}>
      <span aria-hidden>{GLYPH[status] ?? "•"}</span> {status}
    </Badge>
  );
}

export const isActiveRun = (status: string) => status === "queued" || status === "running";

/** Headline metrics: prefer the full pipeline, otherwise the first configuration. */
export function headlineConfig(configs: string[], metrics: Record<string, unknown>): string | undefined {
  if (metrics["L1+L2+L3"]) return "L1+L2+L3";
  return configs.find((c) => metrics[c]) ?? Object.keys(metrics)[0];
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ApiErrorMessage, useErrorToast, type DisplayError } from "@/components/api-error";
import { RunStatus, headlineConfig, isActiveRun } from "@/components/run-status";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Label, Select } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Alert, Spinner, TableScroll, td, th } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/toast";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { fmtDateTime, fmtPct, fmtScore } from "@/lib/format";
import { EVAL_CONFIGS, type EvalRun } from "@/lib/schemas";

export function EvaluationClient({
  isAdmin,
  initialRuns,
  initialError,
}: {
  isAdmin: boolean;
  initialRuns: EvalRun[];
  initialError: { status: number; code: string; message: string; request_id: string } | null;
}) {
  const [runs, setRuns] = React.useState<EvalRun[]>(initialRuns);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(
    initialError ? { status: initialError.status, code: initialError.code, message: initialError.message, requestId: initialError.request_id } : null,
  );
  const [newOpen, setNewOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const showError = useErrorToast();

  const reload = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch<{ runs: EvalRun[] }>("/api/eval-runs");
      setRuns(res.runs);
      setError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(showError(e, "Could not load runs"));
    }
  }, [showError]);

  // Live poll every 5 s while any run is queued or running.
  const anyActive = runs.some((r) => isActiveRun(r.status));
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!anyActive) return;
    const id = window.setInterval(() => void reload(), 5000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [anyActive, reload]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
          {anyActive ? "A run is in progress — refreshing every 5 s." : `${runs.length} run${runs.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`}
        </p>
        {isAdmin ? <Button onClick={() => setNewOpen(true)}>New run</Button> : null}
      </div>
      <ApiErrorMessage error={error} title="Could not load runs" />
      <TableScroll label="Evaluation runs">
        <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              {["Run ID", "Dataset", "Configurations", "Status", "Created by", "Created", "Headline F1", "Headline FPR"].map((h) => (
                <th key={h} scope="col" className={th}>
                  {h}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {runs.map((r) => {
              const hc = headlineConfig(r.configs, r.metrics);
              const m = hc ? r.metrics[hc] : undefined;
              return (
                <tr key={r.run_id} data-testid="run-row">
                  <td className={td}>
                    <Link href={`/evaluation/${encodeURIComponent(r.run_id)}`} className="font-mono text-xs text-primary underline-offset-2 hover:underline">
                      {r.run_id}
                    </Link>
                  </td>
                  <td className={td}>{r.dataset_version}</td>
                  <td className={`${td} text-xs`}>
                    {r.configs.join(", ")}
                    {r.thresholds_sweep ? " · sweep" : ""}
                  </td>
                  <td className={td}>
                    <RunStatus status={r.status} />
                  </td>
                  <td className={`${td} break-all text-xs`}>{r.created_by ?? "—"}</td>
                  <td className={td}>
                    <time dateTime={r.created_at} suppressHydrationWarning>
                      {fmtDateTime(r.created_at)}
                    </time>
                  </td>
                  <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>
                    {fmtScore(m?.f1, 3)}
                    {hc && m ? <span className="block text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{hc}</span> : null}
                  </td>
                  <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtPct(m?.fpr)}</td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
            {runs.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={8} className={`${td} py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground`}>
                  No evaluation runs yet.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : null}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </TableScroll>
      {isAdmin ? (
        <NewRunDialog
          open={newOpen}
          onClose={() => setNewOpen(false)}
          onCreated={() => {
            setNewOpen(false);
            void reload();
          }}
        />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function NewRunDialog({ open, onClose, onCreated }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onCreated: () => void }) {
  const [datasets, setDatasets] = React.useState<{ dataset_version: string; item_count?: number }[] | null>(null);
  const [dataset, setDataset] = React.useState("");
  const [configs, setConfigs] = React.useState<string[]>(["L1", "L1+L2", "L1+L2+L3"]);
  const [sweep, setSweep] = React.useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(null);
  const showError = useErrorToast();
  const { toast } = useToast();

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || datasets) return;
    apiFetch<{ datasets: { dataset_version: string; item_count?: number }[] }>("/api/datasets")
      .then((d) => {
        setDatasets(d.datasets);
        if (d.datasets[0]) setDataset((cur) => cur || d.datasets[0]!.dataset_version);
      })
      .catch((e) => setError(showError(e, "Could not load datasets")));
  }, [open, datasets, showError]);

  const submit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!dataset || !configs.length) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiFetch("/api/eval-runs", { method: "POST", json: { dataset_version: dataset, configs, thresholds_sweep: sweep } });
      toast({ tone: "success", title: "Evaluation run started" });
      onCreated();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(showError(err, "Could not start run"));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={() => !busy && onClose()} title="New evaluation run">
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <Label htmlFor="nr-dataset">Dataset version</Label>
          <Select id="nr-dataset" value={dataset} onChange={(e) => setDataset(e.target.value)} disabled={!datasets?.length}>
            {!datasets ? <option value="">Loading…</option> : null}
            {datasets && !datasets.length ? <option value="">No datasets</option> : null}
            {datasets?.map((d) => (
              <option key={d.dataset_version} value={d.dataset_version}>
                {d.dataset_version}
                {d.item_count ? ` (${d.item_count} items)` : ""}
              </option>
            ))}
          </Select>
        </div>
        <fieldset>
          <legend className="text-sm font-medium">Configurations</legend>
          <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {EVAL_CONFIGS.map((c) => (
              <label key={c} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={configs.includes(c)} onChange={() => setConfigs((xs) => (xs.includes(c) ? xs.filter((x) => x !== c) : [...xs, c]))} />
                <code>{c}</code>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
          {!configs.length ? (
            <p role="alert" className="mt-1 text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
              Select at least one configuration.
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </fieldset>
        <Switch checked={sweep} onCheckedChange={setSweep} label="Threshold sweep" />
        <ApiErrorMessage error={error} title="Request failed" />
        {configs.includes("L1+L2+L3") || configs.includes("bedrock_guardrails") ? (
          <Alert tone="info">Configurations with the judge or Bedrock Guardrails call Bedrock and incur cost.</Alert>
        ) : null}
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={busy || !dataset || !configs.length}>
            {busy ? <Spinner label="Starting" /> : null}
            Start run
          </Button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { RunDetailClient } from "./run-detail-client";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Evaluation run" };

// Data is loaded through /api/eval-runs/[runId], which also merges results.json from S3.
export default async function RunDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ runId: string }> }) {

            Back to runs
          </Link>
        }
      />
      <RunDetailClient runId={runId} />
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, Legend, Line, LineChart, ReferenceDot, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
import { ApiErrorMessage, toDisplayError, type DisplayError } from "@/components/api-error";
import { ChartCard } from "@/components/chart-card";
import { PlainText } from "@/components/highlighted-text";
import { RunStatus, isActiveRun } from "@/components/run-status";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Label, Select } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Alert, Spinner, TableScroll, td, th } from "@/components/ui/misc";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api-client";
import { fmtDateTime, fmtMs, fmtPct, fmtScore } from "@/lib/format";
import type { ConfigMetrics, EvalRunDetail, Misclassified } from "@/lib/schemas";

const SERIES_COLORS = ["#1d4ed8", "#b45309", "#047857", "#7c3aed", "#be123c"];

function ConfusionMatrix({ config, m }: { config: string; m: ConfigMetrics }) {
  const cell = (label: string, v: number | undefined, good: boolean) => (
    <td className={`border p-3 text-center ${good ? "bg-green-50" : "bg-red-50"}`}>
      <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums">{v ?? "—"}</span>
    </td>
  );
  return (
    <div>
      <h3 className="mb-1 font-mono text-sm font-medium">{config}</h3>
      <table className="border-collapse text-sm">
        <caption className="sr-only">Confusion matrix for {config}</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <td />
            <th scope="col" className="border bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-xs">Predicted attack</th>
            <th scope="col" className="border bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-xs">Predicted benign</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row" className="border bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs">Actual attack</th>
            {cell("TP", m.tp, true)}
            {cell("FN", m.fn, false)}
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <th scope="row" className="border bg-muted px-3 py-1 text-left text-xs">Actual benign</th>
            {cell("FP", m.fp, false)}
            {cell("TN", m.tn, true)}
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

function docText(d: Misclassified["context_docs"][number]): string {
  return typeof d === "string" ? d : d.content;
}

function safeHref(url: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!url) return null;
  try {
    return new URL(url).protocol === "https:" ? url : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function RunDetailClient({ runId }: { runId: string }) {
  const [run, setRun] = React.useState<EvalRunDetail | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<DisplayError | null>(null);
  const [kindFilter, setKindFilter] = React.useState<"all" | "fp" | "fn">("all");
  const [configFilter, setConfigFilter] = React.useState("all");

  const load = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const r = await apiFetch<EvalRunDetail>(`/api/eval-runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}`);
      setRun(r);
      setError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(toDisplayError(e));
    }
  }, [runId]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const active = run ? isActiveRun(run.status) : false;
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    const id = window.setInterval(() => void load(), 5000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [active, load]);

  const configs = React.useMemo(() => (run ? run.configs.filter((c) => run.metrics[c]).concat(Object.keys(run.metrics).filter((c) => !run.configs.includes(c))) : []), [run]);

  const categoryRows = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!run) return [];
    const cats = new Set<string>();
    for (const c of configs) Object.keys(run.metrics[c]?.per_category_recall ?? {}).forEach((k) => cats.add(k));
    return Array.from(cats)
      .sort()
      .map((category) => {
        const row: Record<string, string | number | null> = { category };
        for (const c of configs) row[c] = run.metrics[c]?.per_category_recall?.[category] ?? null;
        return row;
      });
  }, [run, configs]);

  const sweepConfigs = React.useMemo(() => Object.keys(run?.sweep ?? {}), [run]);
  const prRows = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!run?.sweep) return [];
    const rows: { config: string; threshold: number; precision: number | null; recall: number | null; fpr: number | null }[] = [];
    for (const [config, pts] of Object.entries(run.sweep)) for (const p of pts) rows.push({ config, threshold: p.threshold, precision: p.precision, recall: p.recall, fpr: p.fpr ?? null });
    return rows;
  }, [run]);
  const defaultThreshold = run?.default_threshold ?? 0.5;

  if (!run) {
    return error ? (
      <ApiErrorMessage error={error} title="Could not load run" />
    ) : (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-8 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        <Spinner label="Loading run" /> Loading run…
      </div>
    );
  }

  const misclassified = (run.misclassified ?? []).filter((m) => (kindFilter === "all" || m.kind === kindFilter) && (configFilter === "all" || m.config === configFilter));
  const resultsHref = safeHref(run.results_url);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <ApiErrorMessage error={error} title="Refresh failed" />
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 p-4 text-sm">
          <RunStatus status={run.status} />
          <span>
            Dataset <strong>{run.dataset_version}</strong>
          </span>
          <span>Configurations: {run.configs.join(", ")}</span>
          <span>Sweep: {run.thresholds_sweep ? "yes" : "no"}</span>
          <span>Created {fmtDateTime(run.created_at)}{run.created_by ? ` by ${run.created_by}` : ""}</span>
          {run.finished_at ? <span>Finished {fmtDateTime(run.finished_at)}</span> : null}
          {active ? (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
              <Spinner label="Run in progress" /> refreshing every 5 s
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {run.status === "failed" ? (
        <Alert tone="error" title="Run failed">
          <PlainText text={run.error ?? "No error message recorded."} />
        </Alert>
      ) : null}

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Metrics</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {configs.length ? (
            <TableScroll label="Metrics per configuration">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    {["Configuration", "Precision", "Recall", "F1", "FPR", "FPR (hard negatives)", "p50 latency", "p95 latency", "Judge escalation", "Cost / 1,000 req"].map((h) => (
                      <th key={h} scope="col" className={th}>
                        {h}
                      </th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {configs.map((c) => {
                    const m = run.metrics[c]!;
                    return (
                      <tr key={c}>
                        <th scope="row" className={`${td} text-left font-mono text-xs`}>
                          {c}
                        </th>
                        <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtScore(m.precision, 3)}</td>
                        <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtScore(m.recall, 3)}</td>
                        <td className={`${td} tabular-nums font-semibold`}>{fmtScore(m.f1, 3)}</td>
                        <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtPct(m.fpr)}</td>
                        <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtPct(m.fpr_hard)}</td>
                        <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtMs(m.p50_ms)}</td>
                        <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtMs(m.p95_ms)}</td>
                        <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtPct(m.judge_escalation_rate)}</td>
                        <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{typeof m.cost_per_1k === "number" ? `$${m.cost_per_1k.toFixed(4)}` : "—"}</td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </TableScroll>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{active ? "Metrics appear when the run finishes." : "No metrics recorded."}</p>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {configs.length ? (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Confusion matrices</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-wrap gap-6">
            {configs.map((c) => (
              <ConfusionMatrix key={c} config={c} m={run.metrics[c]!} />
            ))}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <ChartCard
          title="Recall per attack category"
          description="Grouped by configuration"
          rows={categoryRows}
          columns={[
            { key: "category", header: "Category", render: (r) => String(r.category) },
            ...configs.map((c) => ({ key: c, header: c, render: (r: Record<string, string | number | null>) => fmtScore(r[c] as number | null, 3) })),
          ]}
        >
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <BarChart data={categoryRows}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis dataKey="category" tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "#334155" }} />
              <YAxis domain={[0, 1]} tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "#334155" }} />
              <Tooltip formatter={(v) => fmtScore(Number(v), 3)} />
              <Legend />
              {configs.map((c, i) => (
                <Bar key={c} dataKey={c} name={c} fill={SERIES_COLORS[i % SERIES_COLORS.length]} />
              ))}
            </BarChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </ChartCard>

        <ChartCard
          title="Precision–recall curve"
          description={`Threshold sweep 0.05–0.95; the dot marks the current default threshold (${defaultThreshold.toFixed(2)}).`}
          rows={prRows}
          emptyText={run.thresholds_sweep ? "Sweep results are not available yet." : "This run did not include a threshold sweep."}
          columns={[
            { key: "config", header: "Configuration", render: (r) => r.config },
            { key: "t", header: "Threshold", render: (r) => `${r.threshold.toFixed(2)}${Math.abs(r.threshold - defaultThreshold) < 1e-9 ? " (default)" : ""}` },
            { key: "p", header: "Precision", render: (r) => fmtScore(r.precision, 3) },
            { key: "r", header: "Recall", render: (r) => fmtScore(r.recall, 3) },
            { key: "f", header: "FPR", render: (r) => fmtPct(r.fpr) },
          ]}
        >
          <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
            <LineChart>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />
              <XAxis type="number" dataKey="recall" name="Recall" domain={[0, 1]} tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "#334155" }} label={{ value: "Recall", position: "insideBottom", offset: -2, fontSize: 11 }} />
              <YAxis type="number" dataKey="precision" name="Precision" domain={[0, 1]} tick={{ fontSize: 11, fill: "#334155" }} />
              <Tooltip formatter={(v) => fmtScore(Number(v), 3)} />
              <Legend />
              {sweepConfigs.map((c, i) => {
                const pts = (run.sweep?.[c] ?? []).filter((p) => p.recall !== null && p.precision !== null).sort((a, b) => (a.recall ?? 0) - (b.recall ?? 0));
                const def = pts.find((p) => Math.abs(p.threshold - defaultThreshold) < 1e-9);
                const color = SERIES_COLORS[i % SERIES_COLORS.length];
                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={c}>
                    <Line data={pts} type="monotone" dataKey="precision" name={c} stroke={color} strokeWidth={2} dot={false} />
                    {def ? <ReferenceDot x={def.recall ?? 0} y={def.precision ?? 0} r={6} fill={color} stroke="#0f172a" label={{ value: `t=${defaultThreshold.toFixed(2)}`, position: "top", fontSize: 10 }} /> : null}
                  </React.Fragment>
                );
              })}
            </LineChart>
          </ResponsiveContainer>
        </ChartCard>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Misclassified items</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="mc-kind">Type</Label>
              <Select id="mc-kind" value={kindFilter} onChange={(e) => setKindFilter(e.target.value as "all" | "fp" | "fn")} className="w-48">
                <option value="all">All</option>
                <option value="fp">False positives</option>
                <option value="fn">False negatives</option>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="mc-config">Configuration</Label>
              <Select id="mc-config" value={configFilter} onChange={(e) => setConfigFilter(e.target.value)} className="w-48">
                <option value="all">All</option>
                {configs.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c} value={c}>
                    {c}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <TableScroll label="Misclassified items">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {["Item", "Configuration", "Type", "Label", "Category", "Action", "Risk", "Text"].map((h) => (
                    <th key={h} scope="col" className={th}>
                      {h}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {misclassified.slice(0, 500).map((m, i) => (
                  <tr key={`${m.config}-${m.id}-${i}`}>
                    <td className={`${td} font-mono text-xs`}>{m.id}</td>
                    <td className={`${td} font-mono text-xs`}>{m.config}</td>
                    <td className={td}>{m.kind === "fp" ? "False positive" : m.kind === "fn" ? "False negative" : m.kind}</td>
                    <td className={td}>{m.label ?? "—"}</td>
                    <td className={td}>{m.category ?? "—"}</td>
                    <td className={td}>{m.action ? m.action.toUpperCase() : "—"}</td>
                    <td className={`${td} tabular-nums`}>{fmtScore(m.risk)}</td>
                    <td className={`${td} min-w-[24rem]`}>
                      {/* Full text is shown because evaluation data is public or synthetic; rendered as plain text (FE-14). */}
                      <PlainText text={m.input || "(no user input)"} className="max-h-48 overflow-auto" />
                      {m.context_docs.map((d, j) => (
                        <PlainText key={j} text={docText(d)} className="mt-1 max-h-48 overflow-auto bg-amber-50/50" />
                      ))}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
                {misclassified.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={8} className={`${td} py-6 text-center text-muted-foreground`}>
                      {run.misclassified ? "No misclassified items for this filter." : "Misclassified items are not available yet."}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : null}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </TableScroll>
          {misclassified.length > 500 ? <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Showing the first 500 of {misclassified.length}. Download the predictions for the full list.</p> : null}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Downloads</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <ul className="space-y-1 text-sm">
            <li>
              {resultsHref ? (
                <a href={resultsHref} className="text-primary underline" rel="noopener noreferrer" download>
                  results.json
                </a>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">results.json — not available yet</span>
              )}
            </li>
            {Object.entries(run.predictions_urls ?? {}).map(([config, url]) => {
              const href = safeHref(url);
              return (
                <li key={config}>
                  {href ? (
                    <a href={href} className="text-primary underline" rel="noopener noreferrer" download>
                      predictions/{config}.jsonl
                    </a>
                  ) : (
                    <span>predictions/{config}.jsonl</span>
                  )}
                </li>
              );
            })}
            {!run.predictions_urls || !Object.keys(run.predictions_urls).length ? <li className="text-muted-foreground">Predictions JSONL — not available yet</li> : null}
          </ul>
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Links are short-lived presigned URLs; reload the page if one has expired.</p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { DEFAULT_POLICY, diffObjects, validatePolicy, type Policy } from "@/lib/policy";
import { PolicyUpdateRequestSchema } from "@/lib/schemas";

function withPolicy(patch: (p: Policy) => void): Policy {
  const p = structuredClone(DEFAULT_POLICY);
  patch(p);
  return p;
}

describe("policy validation (CORE-22 mirror)", () => {
  it("accepts the default policy", () => {
    expect(validatePolicy(DEFAULT_POLICY).ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it("test_AC_FE_5: flag=0.9, sanitize=0.7 is rejected with an error naming both fields on both fields", () => {
    const res = validatePolicy(withPolicy((p) => {
      p.thresholds.flag = 0.9;
      p.thresholds.sanitize = 0.7;
    }));
    expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
    if (res.ok) return;
    const flagMsgs = res.errors["thresholds.flag"] ?? [];
    const sanitizeMsgs = res.errors["thresholds.sanitize"] ?? [];
    expect(flagMsgs.join(" ")).toMatch(/Flag threshold/);
    expect(flagMsgs.join(" ")).toMatch(/Sanitize threshold/);
    expect(sanitizeMsgs).toEqual(flagMsgs.filter((m) => m.includes("Sanitize")));
    expect(flagMsgs).toContain("Flag threshold must be ≤ Sanitize threshold");
  });

  it("rejects sanitize > block naming both fields", () => {
    const res = validatePolicy(withPolicy((p) => {
      p.thresholds.sanitize = 0.9;
      p.thresholds.block = 0.8;
    }));
    expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
    if (res.ok) return;
    expect(res.errors["thresholds.block"]).toContain("Sanitize threshold must be ≤ Block threshold");
    expect(res.errors["thresholds.sanitize"]).toContain("Sanitize threshold must be ≤ Block threshold");
  });

  it("rejects flag = 0 and block > 1", () => {
    const res = validatePolicy(withPolicy((p) => {
      p.thresholds.flag = 0;
      p.thresholds.block = 1.2;
    }));
    expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
    if (res.ok) return;
    expect(res.errors["thresholds.flag"]).toContain("Flag threshold must be > 0");
    expect(res.errors["thresholds.block"]).toContain("Block threshold must be ≤ 1");
  });

  it("accepts equal thresholds (≤ is inclusive)", () => {
    expect(validatePolicy(withPolicy((p) => {
      p.thresholds = { flag: 0.7, sanitize: 0.7, block: 0.7 };
    })).ok).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects gray zone low ≥ high naming both fields", () => {
    const res = validatePolicy(withPolicy((p) => {
      p.gray_zone = { low: 0.8, high: 0.8 };
    }));
    expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
    if (res.ok) return;
    expect(res.errors["gray_zone.low"]).toContain("Gray zone low must be < Gray zone high");
    expect(res.errors["gray_zone.high"]).toContain("Gray zone low must be < Gray zone high");
  });

  it("rejects a non-numeric threshold", () => {
    const res = validatePolicy(withPolicy((p) => {
      p.thresholds.flag = Number.NaN;
    }));
    expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
  });

  it("rejects a fractional judge budget", () => {
    const res = validatePolicy(withPolicy((p) => {
      p.judge_budget = 1.5;
    }));
    expect(res.ok).toBe(false);
    if (res.ok) return;
    expect(res.errors.judge_budget?.[0]).toMatch(/whole number/);
  });

  it("BFF request schema enforces the same cross-field rules", () => {
    const bad = PolicyUpdateRequestSchema.safeParse({
      policy: withPolicy((p) => {
        p.thresholds.flag = 0.9;
        p.thresholds.sanitize = 0.7;
      }),
      policy_version: 3,
    });
    expect(bad.success).toBe(false);
    const good = PolicyUpdateRequestSchema.safeParse({ policy: DEFAULT_POLICY, policy_version: 3, allowed_link_domains: ["example.com"] });
    expect(good.success).toBe(true);
  });

  it("BFF request schema rejects unknown fields", () => {
    expect(PolicyUpdateRequestSchema.safeParse({ policy: DEFAULT_POLICY, policy_version: 1, extra: true }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("policy diff preview", () => {
  it("lists only changed fields with labels", () => {
    const after = withPolicy((p) => {
      p.mode = "monitor";
      p.custom_rules.deny_phrases = ["promo code"];
    });
    const rows = diffObjects(DEFAULT_POLICY, after);
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.field)).toEqual(["custom_rules.deny_phrases", "mode"]);
    expect(rows.find((r) => r.field === "mode")).toMatchObject({ label: "Mode", before: "enforce", after: "monitor" });
    expect(rows.find((r) => r.field === "custom_rules.deny_phrases")).toMatchObject({ before: "(none)", after: "promo code" });
  });

  it("is empty when nothing changed", () => {
    expect(diffObjects(DEFAULT_POLICY, structuredClone(DEFAULT_POLICY))).toEqual([]);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { splitAtSpans } from "@/lib/highlight";

const joined = (pieces: { text: string }[]) => pieces.map((p) => p.text).join("");

describe("splitAtSpans (FE-14)", () => {
  it("returns the whole text unhighlighted when there are no spans", () => {
    expect(splitAtSpans("hello", [])).toEqual([{ text: "hello", highlighted: false, labels: [] }]);
  });

  it("returns nothing for empty text", () => {
    expect(splitAtSpans("", [{ start: 0, end: 3 }])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("splits around a single span", () => {
    const pieces = splitAtSpans("Please ignore previous instructions now", [{ start: 7, end: 35, label: "instruction_override" }]);
    expect(pieces).toEqual([
      { text: "Please ", highlighted: false, labels: [] },
      { text: "ignore previous instructions", highlighted: true, labels: ["instruction_override"] },
      { text: " now", highlighted: false, labels: [] },
    ]);
  });

  it("handles spans at the start and end", () => {
    const pieces = splitAtSpans("abcdef", [
      { start: 0, end: 2 },
      { start: 4, end: 6 },
    ]);
    expect(pieces.map((p) => [p.text, p.highlighted])).toEqual([
      ["ab", true],
      ["cd", false],
      ["ef", true],
    ]);
  });

  it("merges overlapping spans and keeps both labels on the overlap", () => {
    const pieces = splitAtSpans("0123456789", [
      { start: 2, end: 6, label: "a" },
      { start: 4, end: 8, label: "b" },
    ]);
    expect(pieces).toEqual([
      { text: "01", highlighted: false, labels: [] },
      { text: "23", highlighted: true, labels: ["a"] },
      { text: "45", highlighted: true, labels: ["a", "b"] },
      { text: "67", highlighted: true, labels: ["b"] },
      { text: "89", highlighted: false, labels: [] },
    ]);
    expect(joined(pieces)).toBe("0123456789");
  });

  it("clamps out-of-range spans and ignores empty or inverted ones", () => {
    const pieces = splitAtSpans("abc", [
      { start: -5, end: 1 },
      { start: 2, end: 99 },
      { start: 2, end: 2 },
      { start: 3, end: 1 },
    ]);
    expect(pieces.map((p) => [p.text, p.highlighted])).toEqual([
      ["a", true],
      ["b", false],
      ["c", true],
    ]);
  });

  it("counts offsets in code points, not UTF-16 units", () => {
    // "😀" is one code point but two UTF-16 units; the span [2,8) must still cover "ignore".
    const text = "😀 ignore this";
    const pieces = splitAtSpans(text, [{ start: 2, end: 8 }]);
    expect(pieces.find((p) => p.highlighted)?.text).toBe("ignore");
    expect(joined(pieces)).toBe(text);
  });

  it("never interprets markup: HTML stays literal text", () => {
    const text = "<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>";
    const pieces = splitAtSpans(text, [{ start: 5, end: 10 }]);
    expect(joined(pieces)).toBe(text);
    expect(pieces[1]).toMatchObject({ text: "src=x", highlighted: true });
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { DEFAULT_FILTERS, filtersToApiQuery, filtersToSearch, parseFilters } from "@/lib/verdict-filters";

describe("verdict filters in the URL (AC-FE-8)", () => {
  it("round-trips through the query string", () => {
    const f = { ...DEFAULT_FILTERS, app: "support-bot", actions: ["block", "flag"] as ("block" | "flag")[], range: "7d" as const, minRisk: 0.6, origins: ["api" as const] };
    const qs = filtersToSearch(f);
    expect(parseFilters(new URLSearchParams(qs))).toEqual(f);
  });

  it("defaults exclude playground and produce an empty query", () => {
    expect(filtersToSearch(DEFAULT_FILTERS)).toBe("");
    expect(parseFilters(new URLSearchParams()).origins).toEqual(["api", "chat"]);
  });

  it("drops invalid values", () => {
    const f = parseFilters(new URLSearchParams("app=Bad App&action=block,nope&range=1y&min_risk=7"));
    expect(f).toEqual({ ...DEFAULT_FILTERS, actions: ["block"] });
  });

  it("builds the backend query with a time window", () => {
    const now = Date.parse("2026-10-16T12:00:00Z");
    const q = filtersToApiQuery({ ...DEFAULT_FILTERS, range: "1h" }, now, "abc");
    expect(q.get("from")).toBe("2026-10-16T11:00:00.000Z");
    expect(q.get("to")).toBe("2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(q.get("origin")).toBe("api,chat");
    expect(q.get("cursor")).toBe("abc");
  });
});

import { defineConfig, devices } from "@playwright/test";

// E2E against a running dashboard (local `npm run start`, a Vercel preview, or production).
//   E2E_BASE_URL               base URL, default http://localhost:3000
//   E2E_ADMIN_USERNAME/_PASSWORD, E2E_ANALYST_USERNAME/_PASSWORD   Cognito test users (dev pool)
//   E2E_APP_ID                 an existing app whose policy the tests may edit (AC-FE-6)
//   E2E_AWS_ACCOUNT_ID         searched for in the client bundle (AC-FE-9)
const baseURL = process.env.E2E_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";

export default defineConfig({
  testDir: "./e2e",
  timeout: 60_000,
  expect: { timeout: 15_000 },
  fullyParallel: false,
  retries: process.env.CI ? 1 : 0,
  reporter: process.env.CI ? [["list"], ["html", { open: "never" }]] : "list",
  use: {
    baseURL,
    trace: "retain-on-failure",
    screenshot: "only-on-failure",
  },
  projects: [
    { name: "setup", testMatch: /auth\.setup\.ts/ },
    {
      name: "chromium",
      use: { ...devices["Desktop Chrome"] },
      dependencies: ["setup"],
    },
  ],
});

import path from "node:path";
import { test, type Browser, type Page } from "@playwright/test";

export type E2ERole = "admin" | "analyst";

export const STATE_DIR = path.join(__dirname, ".auth");
export const statePath = (role: E2ERole) => path.join(STATE_DIR, `${role}.json`);

export function credentials(role: E2ERole): { username: string; password: string } | null {
  const prefix = role === "admin" ? "E2E_ADMIN" : "E2E_ANALYST";
  const username = process.env[`${prefix}_USERNAME`];
  const password = process.env[`${prefix}_PASSWORD`];
  return username && password ? { username, password } : null;
}

/** Skip the current test when the role's test user is not configured. */
export function requireRole(role: E2ERole) {
  test.skip(!credentials(role), `E2E_${role.toUpperCase()}_USERNAME / _PASSWORD not set`);
}

export async function pageAs(browser: Browser, role: E2ERole): Promise<Page> {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ storageState: statePath(role) });
  return context.newPage();
}

/** Sign in through the Cognito Hosted UI (classic or managed login). */
export async function signInViaHostedUi(page: Page, username: string, password: string) {
  await page.goto("/login");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /sign in with cognito/i }).click();
  await page.waitForURL((url) => !url.toString().startsWith(process.env.E2E_BASE_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000"));
  const user = page.locator('input[name="username"]:visible, input[type="email"]:visible').first();
  await user.fill(username);
  const pass = page.locator('input[name="password"]:visible, input[type="password"]:visible').first();
  if (!(await pass.isVisible().catch(() => false))) {
    // Managed login asks for the username first.
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: /next|continue/i }).first().click();
  }
  await pass.fill(password);
  await page.locator('input[type="submit"]:visible, button[type="submit"]:visible').first().click();
  await page.waitForURL(/\/playground/);
}

import fs from "node:fs";
import { test as setup } from "@playwright/test";
import { STATE_DIR, credentials, signInViaHostedUi, statePath, type E2ERole } from "./helpers";

fs.mkdirSync(STATE_DIR, { recursive: true });

for (const role of ["admin", "analyst"] as E2ERole[]) {
  setup(`authenticate as ${role}`, async ({ page }) => {
    const creds = credentials(role);
    setup.skip(!creds, `No ${role} test user configured`);
    await signInViaHostedUi(page, creds!.username, creds!.password);
    await page.context().storageState({ path: statePath(role) });
  });
}
